Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['The Nebra is one of the greatest rivers in Dalmasca. She carries strange gifts, for those with eyes to look. Discarded trinkets, lost coin purses ... even messages in bottles have I found on my daily walks of her banks.', 'I was walking along the riverbank when I saw it - a boat set adrift from the north bank. Of course I told everyone as soon as I could. No good can come of this ...', "I can't believe the cactoids would attack the village. I've never seen anything like it."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["You're a spirited one to walk these mountain roads, boy. Misplaced your airship, perhaps? Ha ha ha! About the only ones traveling on foot these days are those without two coins to rub together, dyed-in-the-wool travelers, or else ... But I don't mean to pry, and I won't. Going to Archadia? You'll want to cross the mountains to the north, then go east through the forest.", "I'll admit, when the water started flowing from the shrine, I was quite surprised. Take a look, boy, it's quite beautiful. That one over there, he's come all the way from Archades to visit this shrine and learn its secrets."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Today all work in the mines had stopped, bhadra. An inspection party has come from Archadia, yes. They have brought many guards. There is no need for our guild of bodyguards, the parivir.', 'The one with the shiny armor, he was a Judge of Archadia, yes? Haa ... More impressive than ever I imagined, he was! The Marquis must do as they say.', 'They say that those who lost their jobs when the mines closed are to receive a pension. What about we parivir? Do those who guard the workers not deserve the same treatment?']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Oi! That ain't no way to be lookin' at a bird! Betta stay away if ya don't fancy a peckin'! I need me grub if I'm gonna make summink o' meself. An' I betta start makin' summink o' meself soon, while I still got me feathers, innit. Yeah, you 'eard me. Cockatrices can make summink o' theirselves, and I'll prove it. I'll be one o' them belly-wethers, you see if I won't. Dunno 'ow though ... 'Ang about! Wot if I was to find a proper classy fella an' get 'itched? Yeah! That oughta do it! That'd do it, no trouble! Now then ... 'ow'd I find a classy mate?", 'Oh really!?', "In Ol'town, yer say!? Well, 'e does sound classy. I bet 'e's a right toff, wiv blue blood an' ev'ryfink! Prob'ly down in Ol' Archades 'elpin' the poor or summink. Ta very much, darlin'! Well, I'd betta get off an' meet this 'an'some 'unk then, 'adn't I!? Ta-ra!", "'Ave this fer ya trouble, will ya? Go on! Don't be shy! Take it! Take it 'fore I change me mind!", "Right, then! If yer come back when I've made summink o' meself, I'll sort ya out, awright? Make yer a senator or summink! Naahahahaha!", "Good luck!? Wiv feathers like these, I don't need luck, darlin'. All I need's a posh cock wiv a workin' pair of eyes!", "Cor blimey! You're that bloke from Archades, intcha!? Well, don't go nowhere, will ya!? I've got a tragic tale wot needs tellin'. Yer ain't gonna believe this, but that cock wot you set me up wiv in Old Archades ... was only me very own dad! 'E'd vanished when I was scarcely an 'atchlin', see ... I never dreamt 'e'd got taken off to the likes o' that place. 'Is ol' legs was givin' out, but I wanted 'im to see the 'omestead jus' once more. But 'e ... 'e di'nt make it ... (sniff) I-I can't 'old it in no longer! It's gotta come out! Dad!!! Me poor ol' dad! Waaaaaah! Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhhhhhhh!! It's ... it's ... Me poor ol' dad! I don't know 'ow I'm ever gonna get over this, I really don't ... But ... wotever 'appens ... I ain't gonna let nuffink stand in me way ... 'cos one day ... I'm gonna make summink o' meself!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['I do not suppose this is something you might... reconsider?', 'My little emperor-in-waiting. You called and I have come.', "I am but one of very, very many. Try as I might, I could not stop this war alone ... thus I came seeking Larsa's assistance.", 'Al-Cid Margrace, at your service. To think I stand before the Lady Ashe. It is truly an honor.', "I see it is true after all. Ah, stunning is Dalmasca's desert bloom.", 'Hah, Gran Kiltias! You speak much of dreams. But in the real world, war is upon us.', "A word from you and the Resistance would stop cold ... and Rozarria's pretext for joining the war ... scattered, off to the four winds. This was what we had hoped. Alas, circumstances change. A full two years have passed since your reported death. Were it to become known you were still alive ... I fear it could only worsen our current situation.", 'Nay, in fact it has little to do with you.', 'The Emperor Gramis is no more. His life was taken.', 'Let us suppose you approach the Empire with a peaceful resolution. The Late Emperor Gramis would have lent you his ear, that much is certain. But we are dealing with Vayne Solidor. Should the Princess return, he would claim her an imposter. All to tempt the Resistance into battle. Vayne wants this war, that much is certain. As our ill luck would have it, the man is a military genius.', "Archadia's banners fly high. They are making ready for the coming war. According to our latest reports ...", "The Western Armada prepares for war, under Vayne's command no less. The newly formed 12th Fleet has already been deployed. The Imperial 1st Fleet stands ready. They'll be under way as soon as the Odin's refit is complete. And there is more: the 2nd Kerwon Expeditionary Force is being called in ... to replace the missing 8th, so there will be no gaps.", 'The largest force ever seen!', "Larsa has gone to the inner sanctum with the Gran Kiltias. I believe the news of the Emperor's assassination came as something of a shock. Was I overly direct, perhaps? No matter, he is in good hands now.", 'Gone. Spirited away by Judge Gabranth.', 'Ah, as for our young lordling, he went along - to avoid trouble, you see. But Judge Bergan had other ideas. He flew into a rage, and I was left to fend for myself.', 'Please, Princess, you must permit me to take you back with me to Rozarria.', 'I would lay down my life at a single word to be sure ... but I harbor no maundering delusions of valiant grandeur. Vayne has our War Pavilion jumping at shadows. They favor a pre-emptive strike. But you - you will convince them otherwise. You will see that they do not start this war.', 'Ah, this Stone. Do you even know where it is?', 'My leave I take.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['It is Mjrn you seek? She is usually just beyond this bridge, but I tell you now, you search in vain. I should not think she would even know who you are.', 'Golmore Jungle has blessed us with a new herb, and we must decide how best it might be used to enrich our medicines. It is a matter beyond your understanding. I would thank you to interrupt us no further.', 'We discuss the effect different methods of storage have on herbal potency. Do matters so beyond your grasp nonetheless hold interest for you?', 'Would you know more of the Wood? The life that burgeons in Her must be shown the proper respect. Beauty seldom comes without danger. To one who walks in ignorance, the Wood can seem dark, Her life promising naught but death.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['No, my child. I do not sleep. I dream. For reality and illusion are a duality, two parts of a whole. Only the mirror of dreams reflects what is true.', 'Lay down your words. Ashelia, daughter of Raminas, I have dreamt your dream. Who better to carry on the Dalmascan line than she who bears the Dawn Shard? Your dream of a kingdom restored is known to me.', 'In Archadia, Larsa. In Rozarria, Al-Cid. They dream not of war. Should empire join with empire, the way will open for a new Ivalice in our time.', "The dreams have told me thus. To reveal yourself would imperil us all. I see war, and Vayne's name writ bold on history's page.", 'It is the nethicite of which you dream?', 'To wield power against power. Truly the words of a hume-child.', 'Indeed. Then you have but one choice. Seek you the other power Raithwall left.', 'Journey across the Paramina Rift to the Stilshrine of Miriam. There rests the gift he entrusted to the Gran Kiltias of his time. Seek it out. The Sword of Kings can cut through nethicite.', "Why he would entrust the power to destroy nethicite, the instrument of his greatness ... to another and not to his own progeny, I cannot say. Awaken Ashelia B'Nargin and take up your sword, or your dream will remain but a dream.", 'My dream too, fades into day.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Rande! He's a passenger! Mind your tongue! I apologize for my ... companion's behavior. We have cabins available, if you would like to rest until we make port. Would you like me to show you to a cabin?", 'No one. Truly. Just a gentleman – and I use the term loosely – who does not know when enough is enough.', 'Forget my own mother? The mother who raised my sisters single-handedly after my father died in the war? I would never marry a person like you. How many times must I tell you?', "You and your brothers are among the most vulgar men I've ever met. And I've known many vulgars! Using your father to find out where we work! Speaking of work, I'd better get back to it. If you would kindly take your leave, I've a proper passenger to attend to.", 'What manner of game?', 'What of it?', 'Absurd! You expect a perfect stranger to willingly go from airship to airship delivering this message of yours!?', "I'm sorry you've gotten involved in this, sir ... If you do see my sisters on the other airships, perhaps you could show them a letter for me? They're chief stewards, like myself.", "Don't worry about me, sir. My sisters and I are up to the challenge presented by the notorious brothers of House Lirschell. Well, he's distracted me from my duties long enough, I should say. Where were we ... ? Ah, yes! Would you like me to show you to a cabin?", ". I hope you've enjoyed your journey."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Well, hello! The wary traveler never passes the chance to restock his supplies.', 'The children still work, even in this heat. I guess I should try to follow their example.', 'Well, hello! The wary traveler never passes the chance to restock his supplies.', "We will leave before the Rains come. If there's anything you want to buy, now's the time.", 'Well, hello! The wary traveler never passes the chance to restock his supplies.', "I used to live in Rabanastre, before I met my husband. Then I moved here. I only get to see him during the Rains, but I'm happy all the same.", 'Well, hello! The wary traveler never passes the chance to restock his supplies.', "The skies are clear, the food and drink fresh and delicious. The people are good, hard working folk. I've never regretted coming to Giza."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["You stuck here too? I came from the village up ahead, and now I can't get back. Him? Don't worry about him. He won't bite or nothin'. He's practically family! Cute, huh?", "I better get back to the village before they start worrying. Long as we stick together, we'll be okay. Him? Don't worry about him. He won't bite or nothin'. He's practically family!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['The Golmore Jungle to the east of Ozmone Plain is an ancient place that suffers no entry by Man. The wood has a mind of its own. It thinks. Often did the Great-chief tell me to avoid its boughs and winding paths when I was young.', 'You have been to Mt. Bur-Omisace? Where do you go now? I admit, I envy you. I have never been further than the plains in all my years. I, too, wish to see such wonders as the skycities someday ...', 'You have been to Mt. Bur-Omisace? Where do you go now? I admit, I envy you. I have never been further than the Plains in all my years. I, too, wish to see such wonders as the skycities someday ...', 'I have heard that the nomads of Giza herd cockatrices much as we herd nannas. I wonder ... do they eat them? I wonder ... do they taste like chicken?', 'There is to be a war among the humes? At our gathering, so did the Great-Chief and the High-chief say. I fear that it may be true ...', 'I have heard that the nomads of Giza herd cockatrices much as we herd nannas. I wonder ... do they eat them? I wonder ... do they taste like chicken?', 'I have heard that the cockatrice belongs to the nomads of Giza. It is a good thing we did not ea— We did not do anything odd.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["After what you've done! How dare you! You're supposed to be dead!", 'The Resistance.', 'I will not play puppet to Vayne.', "Wait. You took my father's life! Why spare mine now? You would have me live in shame!", "Don't interrupt!", "Don't give it to him!", "It's nothing. I'll be fine.", 'You.', 'I will not place my trust in the sword of a traitor!', 'Very well then.', 'You know nothing of my father!', 'They passed.', 'Perhaps you forgot all that Ondore has wrought.', 'You were only being cautious.', 'I know you would not speak so lightly. Very well.', "When Vossler learned my father had been killed the night of the treaty-signing, he returned to Rabanastre to aid my escape. There was still time before Vayne's reach extended too far. We thought that you could protect me.", 'Halim, we are past all this. Bhujerba must stand with us. We can stop Vayne.', 'Then Bhujerba will aid me?', 'I cannot just wait!', "I'm going to retrieve the Dawn Shard. It's the proof that I need. I know where it's hidden. I'll return his airship later.", "This is something that I have to do! For myself and all those who have fallen. I will not be made to hide! I'll fight alone, if I must.", "I'm trying to concentrate!", "You can't.", "Suppose you kidnapped me instead? You're a sky pirate, aren't you? Then steal me. Is that so much to ask?", "The Dynast-King's treasure. The Dawn Shard is but one of the riches that lie waiting in King Raithwall's tomb.", 'This "come in handy" often?', "Across the sandsea, to the Valley of the Dead. And to King Raithwall's tomb below.", 'Yes, but tell me, Vossler, what have you accomplished?', 'Vossler! Have you found the means to restore Dalmasca?', "Long ago, the gods granted their favor to King Raithwall ... who would oversee the subjugation of a territory spanning from Ordalia to Valendia. Here he forged the Galtean Alliance. Though he is called the Dynast-King ... upon establishing the Alliance, he showed compassion for his people, and disdain for war. A philosophy passed on to his successors. One that would bring peace and prosperity for hundreds of years to follow. It was during this time of peace that the city-states of Archadia and Rozarria ... each members of Raithwall's Alliance, took root and flourished. Raithwall left three relics signifying descent from the Dynast-King. Of these, the Midlight Shard was given to what would become House Nabradia ... and the Dusk Shard to my ancestors, the founders of Dalmasca. The last of these relics was the Dawn Shard. It remained hidden here, known only to those of royal blood.", "But you must consider the prize. The Dawn Shard lies within, and Raithwall's treasure.", 'Yet without help, you and I are as nothing. Is this not so?', 'He thinks ever and always on his own profit. Assure him of it, and he shall remain true to our cause.', 'We will continue this later. Now we should concern ourselves with finding the Dawn Shard.', 'It sleeps, in waiting. Somewhere deep within.', 'I can hear its call.', 'My family tells a story of the Dynast-King and an Esper. The story goes that in his youth, the Dynast-King defeated a mighty gigas ... for which the gods took heed of him. Thereafter, it was bound to him in thralldom.', "Not so. The Esper is the Dynast-King's treasure.", 'In this Esper we now command rests a power whose worth is beyond any measure.', 'What?', 'Rasler ...', 'You will be avenged.', 'Such a heartfelt display of remorse. Now what is it you want?', 'Who are you, Vossler, to talk of trust?', "I like Fran's idea. Let's get out of here!", "I think it's the Dawn Shard.", 'Nabudis.', 'That ridiculous war, the trap at the treaty-signing – all because Vayne wanted power. He must not be allowed to claim the nethicite. The Empire must never hold it.', "Very well, then the path set before us is clear. We'll use the Dawn Shard to fight them! Dalmasca does not forget kindness nor ill deed done. With sword in hand she aids her allies. Sword in hand, she lays to rest her foes. This nethicite I hold must be my sword. I will avenge those who have died. And the Empire will know remorse.", 'Dangerous though it be, what we need now is power. Should we declare Dalmasca free without the means to defend our claim ... the Empire would crush us. You must take me to meet with the garif.', 'Compensation – is that what you want?', "This? Isn't there something else?", 'Regardless, we must go south, yes?', 'I made my resolve two years ago. I swore to overcome any hardship I may face.', 'I must learn more about the nethicite. I cannot turn back now. Please, tell your Great-chief that I am of the royal line of Dalmasca, a direct descendant of Dynast-King Raithwall. If the garif have passed down knowledge of the Stones, they must know of the nethicite that the Dynast-King once held.', 'I ... I do not.', "It was not I who used it. Indeed I had hoped you could show me how. Thus I've come.", 'What?', "Cannot wield it? So then, am I to understand you can't tell me how to use the Stone?", 'To Bur-Omisace?', 'A war?', 'For peace? How dare you say that! The Empire attacked us, stole all we hold dear ... and you would have me save them from war?', 'Rasler.', 'So you did see him, too. But why?', 'Basch told me about him.', 'To protect something.', 'I wish I knew.', 'I will accompany you to Mt. Bur-Omisace.', 'My heart is not set. I still have questions. I hope to find answers along the way.', 'Who is that?', 'He does not mean ill by it.', 'And you can just accept this, can you?', 'My people hate the Empire. They will not accept this.', 'What have we done?', "What's wrong with her?", 'There is a place for all things, even danger such as this.', "Gran Kiltias, I was told my coming here would prevent this war. I was to assume my father's throne and announce the restoration of Dalmasca ... treat with the Empire for peace, and persuade the Resistance to stay their hand. I have not come all this way to be asked to reconsider!", 'Because I am powerless to help.', 'And then ... the nethicite is the coup de grace.', 'Gran Kiltias, Your Grace. I spoke to you of my succession. Let us put that aside. Should I become Queen of Dalmasca now, powerless as I am, I can protect nothing. With a greater power at my disposal, perhaps then.', 'I require something far greater.', 'I am descended from the Dynast-King himself.', 'Does such a thing exist?', 'What?', 'The Stone bleeds Mist.', 'This is the sword. The nethicite destroyer.', 'Vaan.', 'Tell me. Did you see him again?', 'What could it mean?', 'So that you can protect me?', 'This I cannot do. Forgive me, but my errand here is not yet done. I must wield the Sword of Kings, and with it bring an end to the Dusk Shard.', 'At once. As for matters in Rozarria ... I bid you luck.', 'How do you propose we reach Archades?', "Archadia's borders will be well guarded for fear of Rozarrian invasion. We dare not approach by air.", 'The nethicite. I must destroy it.', 'Lusting for ever greater power, blinded by the nethicite.', 'Is that how you see me?', 'You were a ... a Judge!?', "It's hard to leave the past behind. I know.", 'They do, do they?', 'I will play mine.', "I pray you're right, Balthier.", "We'll do what we can to blend into the crowd. Our names may be notorious, but our faces are not far-known.", 'I noticed.', 'Look at this ...', "You're a babbling fool.", 'Your words mean nothing to me!', 'They choose to supply the Resistance, yet raise not a sword in aid. What city could do this?', 'The Marquis — he is set on war?', 'Giruvegan.', "I desire its power. I want ... yet I also fear. I must protect Dalmasca. I can't afford to fear anything.", 'On the farthest shores of the river of time, shrouded deep in the roiling Mist.', 'Is that nethicite?', 'Where is everyone?', 'Such Power exists?', "That's why I was given it — the Sword of Kings.", 'But Venat — Venat is an Occurian. A being like you.', 'Judgment?', 'Destroy them all? The Empire?', 'I will search out the Sun-Cryst.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["What's that, boy? This here's a club for hunters, not children. Run along, now.", "Boy ... you did some huntin' in Sochen, I hear? Guess that game was easier pickin's than the rumors'd have it, eh? Bah. You did for it, so that's that, I suppose. The Huntmaster was sayin' we could start ... ah, but I'm gettin' ahead o' meself. You've business in the capital, no? You get that attended to, then you come back here, and we'll see what you're really made of, boy.", 'Ah, yer back. Talk to the Huntmaster.', "So, yer on the hunt, boy? Do good. The Huntmaster don't carry no baggage.", "So, you passed yer test. If the Huntmaster says yer good enough, then I suppose I might as well put you to work for me. Heh heh. Now listen, this is what I want you to do. There're rare game out there what have mutated. They're a sight meaner than the usual fare. Your usual marks, they get posted after damage has been done, but we want you to find these rare game before lives are lost, see? These rare game, they aren't going to make it easy for you. You have to find 'em and bring 'em down before you know they're rare for sure ... if they drop a trophy when they fall, congratulations, you've just felled yourself rare game. Now, you bring them trophies back here when you get 'em. We won't pay you direct, like with them usual marks, but you'll get yours. See, if you bring in enough trophies, we'll put things out at the Outfitters for you to buy. Give 'em to me, and I'll stock up weapons. ...You could give 'em to my brothers, too, but I don't see why you'd want to do that, really. So, how 'bout it? You want to join the hunt? Say yes, and I'll send you on your way ... and you can turn them trophies in to whom you please. 'Course, that's me, right? Well? You ready?", "Right, then have at it, boy, and bring yer trophies back to me! You get lost, or aren't sure what to do, you talk to the Huntmaster. He's been at this since I was still crawling. He'll learn you right.", 'Feh.', "Hrrm? You don't got a trophy, do you? Try a little harder out there, boy.", 'Ah, yer back. Talk to the Huntmaster.', "So, yer on the hunt, boy? Do good. Say yes, and I'll send you on your way ... and you can turn them trophies in to whom you please. 'Course, that's me, right? Well? You ready?", "Right, then have at it, boy, and bring yer trophies back to me! You get lost, or aren't sure what to do, you talk to the Huntmaster. He's been at this since I was still crawling. He'll learn you right.", 'Feh.', "Hrrm? You don't got a trophy, do you? Try a little harder out there, boy."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["What does that philanderer think he's doing? I was to kill Balthier, not those addle-pated Imperials!", "What, you couldn't hear? I merely said that the lot of you are incompetent fools. If you've the sky pirate in your hands, where is he?", "Eh? What's that you say now? Maybe I'll whet my blade on you ... before I kill Balthier.", "He's in here somewhere! Find him!", "You've seen to her feeding, yes?", "See that she does. We need her alive. Balthier's bait must be fresh.", "Barely know, was it? Yet at a trice, he goes boundin' off for you! Tell me, how could that be?", 'Does that tongue never stop? What if we ... plucked it from your head? As for you, we need Balthier alive! His corpse fetches but half the bounty!', 'You kept us waiting, Balthier!', 'You slipped away in Nalbina. We missed you! First the Judge, and now this boy. The whole affair has the smell of money. I may have to wet my beak a little.', "Balthier! Too long have I gone unpaid! I'll carve my bounty out of that boy!", "The girl? Why keep the bait when you've landed the fish? We cut her loose on the way here and then off she ran, crying like a babe!", 'After them!']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Quite a performance.', 'I play the leading man, who else?', 'Fran, the magicite.', 'And then when I take it from you, it will be mine.', 'Exit stage right.', 'I like it better that way.', "The Ifrit, eh? Impeccable timing. If I didn't know any better, I'd say they were waiting all along.", 'Stop running!', 'End of the line! You have something that belongs to me.', "Fran! Let's move!", 'Off with you!', 'Keep this up and I will!', "What's going on, Fran?", "I don't have time for this.", "Bah, forget it. Even if we could fly ... the Ifrit's playing with fire, and I'd rather not get burned. We'll go the old-fashioned way.", '?', "Well, Fran is special ... in that she'd deign to partner with a hume.", "It's Balthier. Listen thief – Vaan. If you ever want to see your home again, you'll do exactly as I say. Myself, Fran, and you. We're working together now. Understood?", 'The thought never crossed my mind.', "Ah, Vaan. There's something I want to check before we set out.", "As I thought. You don't know much about gambits yet, do you?", "Listen carefully – I don't care to repeat myself. For each gambit, you can combine one action with a target for that action. Example: you can arrange that Cure be cast on an ally whose HP falls below fifty percent. Useful, that. Of course, one error of judgment, and you could well find yourself throwing punches at that same ally. If you've a good head on your shoulders, it should come easily enough. Hmm ... I fear a more detailed explanation is in order.", "This is the Gambit Screen. You can reach it from the Party Menu. To create a Gambit, you need only select an action and a target for that action. Here, let me show you. I'll start by changing the action of one of my gambits.", "Now whenever an ally gets hurt, I'll toss a potion his way. Charming, eh? Of course, that's a sure way to go through our stock of potions. So let's adjust the target to make sure things don't get out of hand.", "Now I'll only ever use potions when an ally's HP drops below seventy percent. That should be a little more bearable. Nothing to it, really. You can set a gambit's action to more or less any ability you have at your disposal.", "Targets aren't so simple. You'll have to pick up new ones from gambit shops.", "But that isn't all. You can also prioritize your gambits. Allow me.", "The gambit in the first slot always takes priority. As it stands now, even if an ally's HP starts to fall, should there be foes near, I'll only attack. For which I could rightly be criticized. In general, it's better to prioritize healing before attacking. Vitality before violence, if you like.", "Oh, another thing – you can turn gambits off and on here, from the Gambit Screen, as well as from the Battle Menu. Of course, gambits won't do you much good if they're turned off. Still, discretion is the better part of valor. If you need to beat a hasty retreat, try turning gambits off first. It's hard to fall back when your allies insist on picking a fight.", "Well, that's the long and short of it. I'll set my gambits as they were before we started. Feel free to change them later if you like.", "We're like to come across new actions and targets, so don't be afraid to experiment with new gambit combinations. But don't put all of your faith in any one combination. With each passing day, the world finds new and exciting ways to kill a man.", 'Be flexible! If you find yourself up against beasts that don\'t take well to fire, create a gambit to cast Fire on nearby foes. Likewise, should we face a creature that used Poison, a gambit to cast Poisona on poisoned allies just might come in handy. A bit much to take in? Don\'t let it worry you – you\'re in good company. Yes, these sewers are thick with the bones of others who had similar "difficulties".', "Let's be off then, shall we?", "Insurgents. Most like they thought to take advantage of a lax watch while the fete's on. ... to feed the good consul a length of steel for his supper. I should think Vayne used to such hospitality. Clever. He used himself as the bait to draw them near, and then sent in the air brigade. A fine, bloody banquet. Hmph. I daresay I've soiled my cuffs. If a dungeon's waiting for us at the end of the night, it had best have a change of wardrobe.", 'And our troubles with them.', "Oh, now, isn't that impressive.", "I'm afraid the jury's still out on that one.", "If they aren't already.", 'You have a lot to learn before we even get started on your thievery.', 'Let\'s think of her as a "guest", then. Unlike Fran or myself, our "guest" won\'t be taking orders from anyone anytime soon. And she\'ll leave when she pleases. So, we keep to our affairs, and she to hers. I doubt we\'ll find her wanting in valor ... being such an upstanding member of the insurgence.', 'Now is not the time.', 'Better than a common assassin.', 'Hold onto this for me, would you? Just until I bring Vaan back.', "All right, all right. Edgy, aren't we?", "You're awake.", "Prison, where else? More a dungeon, but it's really all the same.", "It's just a corpse. Jump at every little thing down here and you'll wear yourself out.", "It's not even a proper dungeon. They just sealed off the bottom level of the fortress. Take a look around. We're not the first they've thrown down here.", "She's off trying to find us a way out.", "Remember what curiosity killed. Just a friendly word of advice. This is all the water we've got. I'd save your strength if I were you.", "Looks as though our belongings were carted off by the Imperials. Ah, perhaps they've brought our things up to our rooms. How kind. No sense strutting about at a time like this. Save your strength, and stay out of trouble.", "Something stinks in here all right. I've changed my mind. This is no dungeon, it's a sty.", "I said you're the one that stinks, hamshanks. Hear me now?", 'You all right, Vaan?', "Great. They just don't give up, do they?", 'Now is looking like a good time for us to leave.', 'Only you sense the Mist.', "Then we'll need magicks.", "Hmph. The self-proclaimed guardians of law and order in Archadia. They're the elite guard of House Solidor. Which effectively makes them the commanders of the Imperial army. If you ask me, they're more executioners than judges. Not a friendly lot, at any rate. What are they doing here?", 'Time for the hare to follow the fox.', "That's why we'll get them to open it for us.", "What's wrong? You don't trust her? Viera's noses are sharp. If she says there's a way out, there's a way out.", 'Ah! The prison repository of wrested relics and raiments.', "That's what I said.", "There are more turnkeys than cutpurses down here. I've had my fill of chains. Let's tread lightly, shall we?", 'This the place?', "It's against my policy to speak with the dead. Especially when they happen to be kingslayers.", 'Is that so? Glad to hear it.', 'Quiet! The guards will hear.', 'Pirates without a sky.', 'Spare us your quiddities.', 'A traitor. I know. Stay here and fight, if you want.', "If you can walk, let's go.", 'We could use another sword arm.', "Let's have a look. Hm ... the fuse is blown. That would explain why there's no power reaching the switch. If the wiring is any indication, I'd say this is a central power relay of some sort. As it stands, I doubt we'll find much still running down here.", "I've heard of these: mimics. They disguise themselves as all manner of things, then strike when you're least weary. Some of them have a fondness for energy, I'm told. They gorge themselves on the stuff until there's naught left.", "Lights out. And it's worse in the dark. Much worse. So, let them get too close one of those conduits and they'll suck it dry. But don't worry: it'll give it back, if you ask it nicely. Sticking it with a sword helps, too. Clock's ticking!", "It reeks. Something's close.", 'Nice moves there, Captain.', "So they say. But I didn't see him kill anyone.", "A twin brother? Fancy that. But still, the pieces fit. I'll give you that much. And he did look like you.", "Believe what you want to. Whatever it takes to make you happy. What's done is done.", "The Estersand, by the look of it. Let's back to Rabanastre before we shrivel up. By your leave, Captain.", "I'd avoid crowds, if I were you. In this town you're still a traitor you know.", "You're a fugitive now, too. Stay low for a while.", "Do as you like. That stone's ill-favored.", 'You offering it?', 'Then why do you ask? Our regards to your girl.', "I believe our business is finished, yes? Hadn't you better say hello to all your little friends?", "That's right. I'd prefer to get that back with as few tear stains as possible. Better hurry.", 'As I said, a misunderstanding.', "I don't respond well to orders. You do know that the Imperial fleet is massing at Bhujerba?", 'An audience with the Marquis, by chance?', 'Make yourselves ready. We leave soon.', "Ba'Gamnan's note can only be referring to the Lhusu Mines in Bhujerba. We'll leave at once. When you're ready, meet me in the aerodrome. I should imagine it's still by the west gate ... We weren't in Nalbina all that long. Do be quick. I'd like to save your girl and be rid of this headache as soon as possible.", "Bhujerba's on the sky continent of Dorstonis, and the magicite mine we're looking for is in Bhujerba. If we're going to save the girl, we start there. You ready to leave?", "You do realize that once we've left, you may not see Rabanastre for a while. Once we leave, there'll be no looking back.", "We make for the Lhusu Mines in Bhujerba. Seems I took on more baggage in Rabanastre than I'd planned ... Well, let's save your girl and be done with it. Come on.", "Don't take too long. We leave soon.", "Don't take too long. We leave soon.", "Don't get out of Dalmasca much, do you ... Bhujerba is a small city-state that thrives on the export of particularly fine magicite. It's ruled by Marquis Ondore, who, by staying in the Empire's good graces, has managed to stave off Imperial invasion.", 'This is the Strahl.', 'She airship enough for you?', 'Well, the headhunters seem to think so.', "What's the good word? Is she ready?", "I suppose I could tell you, but wouldn't you rather see for yourself?", 'Fran, our course.', "Oh, she's free as can be – for now. The Empire took notice when they announced the Princess's unfortunate suicide and your untimely execution.", 'I try to steer clear of such things.', "Right, it's time to fly. And no wagging tongues, or you're like to bite them off.", 'Easy.', "You're a dead man. Don't forget it. And no names.", "The Lhusu Mines are just up ahead. Though, I do hear there's not much left there these days.", 'Right, come on then.', 'Do me a favor and stay where I can keep my eye on you. Should be less trouble that way.', 'The Lhusu Mines: one of the richest veins in Ivalice.', "They say he's been helping the Resistance.", "You're certainly well informed. Who did you say you were again?", 'Errand all attended to, then?', 'No, you\'ll repay us now. We have too much on our hands to go on holding yours. So where did you hear this fairy tale about "nethicite"? And where did you get that sample you carry? What do you know about the Draklor Laboratories? Tell me: who are you?', "Keep your snout in the trough where it belongs. This thinking ill befits you, Ba'Gamnan.", "We'll not be able to take them all! Fight who we must, leave the rest.", "Much more running about with bangaa at my heels ... and I'm apt to give up sky pirating altogether.", 'That\'s no "Lamont." Larsa Ferrinas Solidor. Fourth son to Emperor Gramis ... and brother to Vayne.', 'Nobody knows men like Fran does.', "The Marquis is channeling money to organizations opposing the Empire. We'll start there.", "The men he's been funding bear little love for the Empire. They won't be thrilled to discover that rumors of your death were, in fact, greatly exaggerated. If we were to raise a clamor to that effect, we might just get their attention.", "That certainly qualifies as a clamor. All right, Vaan, get to it. For the girl's sake, eh? Oh, and the more people around to witness your little performance, the better. If we're going to reach the Marquis, it's up to you. We'll be waiting here, if you need us.", "His Excellency Marquis Ondore announced after the war that Captain Basch fon Ronsenburg had been executed ... for slaying his own king. Now, as we all know, Basch lives. Should this become known, why, the Marquis's lie would be revealed, and his Resistance jeopardized.", 'A shame if they learnt the Marquis trafficked with the likes of you. Agents masquerading as guides. A hideout at the back of a tavern. Not exactly earning high marks for originality, are we?', 'For you to calm down.', 'Wait!', 'Vaan. That stone.', 'Tell these Fates of yours to leave me out.', "Oh, I understand. Honor, duty, and all that. I still can't believe that was the Princess.", "We should hurry. They won't be long.", 'The nethicite.', 'An Atomos? All skiff, no ship. Hardly fitting for a leading man.', 'I shall wear it close to my heart.', 'Incidentally, what is the going rate for rescuing princesses these days? Food would be a good start – the good stuff, mind you.', 'Time enough for a bath, I hope. Dirty business, you know. Ah, best bring a change of clothes too.', "That's quite enough, Your Majesty.", 'What do you think? A bit over the top? In my line of work, you never know when something like this might come in handy.', "I'm trying to concentrate!", "I'm leaving you with the Marquis.", "Trust me, you're better off staying here.", 'What do you have that I would want?', 'King Raithwall, you say?', 'How much is the price on your head these days, I wonder?', "It's tough being popular. Wouldn't want admirers dropping in while we're away.", "Well then, that's as far as she goes. We'll be in jagd from here onwards.", 'At least we thought to bring entertainment.', 'Let me guess: sandstorm?', 'We leave at once! This is Urutan-Yensa territory ... and they are unfond of visitors.', "Looks like we've attracted the wrong sort of attention. Let's quit this place while we still can. Move!", "There's no guarantee we'll make it out alive. Vicious beasts. Fiendish traps. Something like that?", 'And there I was thinking this was going to be hard!', "A contraption you'd find in all but the most rudimentary ancient ruin. One touch, and off you're whisked to you know not where. The finer points of their operation elude me, but they're handy all the same. What more need a sky pirate know?", 'Fight or run, we better decide fast!', "So all this time it's been here guarding the Dynast-King's treasure.", "That's your treasure?", 'Is that so? Call me old-fashioned, but I was hoping for a treasure whose worth we could measure.', 'And when all is said and done, your master will have another pet.', 'Well, at least your sword is to the point.', 'What did you say?', "I always knew Fran didn't take well to being tied up. I just never knew how much.", 'How about you?', 'This might get a little dicey.', 'Fran. The Mist. It manifests now.', 'Then what are we waiting for?', 'You know your stuff.', 'More nethicite. Well, no wonder they invaded.', "Oh? They already do. The Dusk Shard, most likely the Midlight Shard, too. Besides, can't they manufact nethicite now?", 'Not exactly close.', "Straight to the point, aren't we. I like that. Compensation?", 'How about the ring.', "No one's forcing you.", "I'll give it back to you. As soon as I find something more valuable.", "Hard to say. I'll know when I find it. What is it you want, Vaan? What are you looking for?", "So they do. We'll need to head south, past the Giza Plains.", 'But those same waters may also lay open new routes to us.', "First things first. You're eager to be on your way, I know ... but we should see that we're prepared before setting out.", 'Man cannot live by resolve alone, princess.', "Don't get your hopes up. You remember the Leviathan sailed straight over the Jagd Yensa, right up to Raithwall's tomb. Skystone that works even in jagd. You know nethicite's behind it. Little wonder they're so keen on the stuff.", "Worried I'm out to steal the nethicite, eh? Can't say I'm unaccustomed to people doubting my intentions. Nothing could be further from my mind. Shall I swear by your sword or some such?", "I'm only here to see how the story unfolds. Any self-respecting leading man would do the same.", 'Making an appearance?', "I thought you'd left for good.", 'And you forsake them in turn?', "Not bad, Vaan. Didn't think we'd get any information out of that one. So then, what was she saying about men in a warren?", "Is that a problem? Let's move.", 'Nice, Vaan.', 'Research.', "So you came here hoping to find something out, and got yourself caught. You're as foolhardy as your sister.", 'Empires parade down city streets, while refugees walk barefoot through the snow.', 'Will he now? You sound sure of yourself. You can never know another, even your father.', "He just may be on to something. The Dawn Shard's no use to us, after all.", 'Should it find its mark.', "Fran, I don't like the look of that.", 'He set his very bones about with manufacted nethicite. The Gran Kiltias?', "I can venture a guess. The Draklor Laboratory. In Archades. The Empire's weapons research begins and ends there. How soon do we leave?", "And their navy will see that the coast is watched as well.. No, we go afoot. We'll cross into Archadia in the Salikawood. We can reach the Wood any number of ways, but the easiest is to head north from Nalbina.", "Getting that far should be half the fun. Let's be sure we go prepared.", "It would seem we made the right choice. If we'd taken the easy way and come by airship ... one of those patrols would no doubt have been quick to roll out the red carpet. We're on the Empire's doorstep now, so we shouldn't have to worry quite so much ... but that's no excuse to get sloppy. It is still a long road to the capital.", 'Why the capital?', "Are you sure? You don't want it for yourself? Use its power to restore Dalmasca — something like that? The best intentions invite the worst kind of trouble.", 'That does sound like someone I know.', "He was obsessed with nethicite. It was all he cared about. He'd babble nonsense, blind to aught but the Stone's power. He'd talk about some 'Eynah,' or was it 'Venat'? No matter. Everything he did, he did to get closer to the nethicite, to understand it. He made airships, weapons ... He even made me a Judge.", "Part of a past I'd rather forget. It didn't last long. I ran. I left the Judges ... and him.", "Cidolfus Demen Bunansa. Draklor Laboratory's very own Dr. Cid. That's when he lost his heart to nethicite, lost himself. And I suppose that's when I lost my father.", "Don't follow in his footsteps.", "I ran away. I couldn't stand seeing him like that, a slave to the Stone. So I ran. Free at last. Funny I went for the Dusk Shard. How could I have known that it was nethicite? And then, of course, I met you. All that running, and I got nowhere. It's time to end this — cut my ties to the past.", "The choice is yours to make. But don't give your heart to a stone. You're too strong for that, Princess.", "Better a hare unseen than a rat in a trap. Then again, if you'd prefer to go knocking on the front gates of the city, be my guest.", 'Even empires have need of sewers. The runoff from Archades proper pools here; those who lack papers to live in the city itself. The mighty who have fallen, and the fallen who would be mighty. Their eyes never leave Archades.', "Oh, to be sure. Archades reeks of a different filth. Let's be off! We can follow our noses to Draklor.", 'Oh wonderful. Enter the streetear.', "An old ... friend. He's a streetear — a peddler of rumor and hearsay, by the name of Jules. He'd bite a gil given him by his own mother, and shave it by half to pay for her funeral.", "Never thought you'd go for such a meager price.", 'Bah.', "We go our separate ways here, Vaan. I've some business to attend to. We'll meet again later.", "Ah, so pleased you could join me. Jules had a morsel for us: a light airship used by Draklor researchers is just up ahead. We'll take that and go on through the service entrance. Let's make haste, shall we?", "Certainly took your time getting here, didn't you. Off seeing the sights, perhaps?", "What's that? But I gave Jules some chops ...", 'Your doing, no doubt. You knew how the Ministry of Law would move, so you had Vaan out collecting chops until the Judges could reinforce Draklor. Of course ... Tell me, how much did the Ministry pay for word of the prodigal son?', "People like ... Rozarrian sympathizers worried about the Empire's weapons programs, and anyone else who might be opposed to House Solidor hegemony. So, we create a disturbance, and you get your windfall of dirt on Draklor.", "Ah, a deal, brokered in true Archades fashion. Why, it's just like old times, Jules. Brings a tear to my eye.", 'Close enough for fisticuffs ... Driver! Faster, if you please. I would be loath to expend any of the violence of my present mood on my companions.', 'This way!', 'Passing strange. There are supposed to be guards here.', "Maybe you're just optimistic.", "No time for caution. Step to it! Cid's chambers are on the top level.", 'The Jagd Difohr, was it? Six years, and ever since you got back, this ... What madness found you there?', "No. We'll use their confusion. We need to find Cid. Now.", "Consider your bones, old man. You're outmatched.", "Treasure. What else would a pirate want? We'll take the Dusk Shard.", 'How could you do this? How could you fall this far?', 'Always hiding behind your toys. Pity if anything were to happen to them.', 'This creature ... So this is your Venat?', 'I hate it when he does that.', "I think not. Cid has the Stone. We grab it, and smash it to pieces with the Sword of Kings. Vayne will be left holding nary a thing. Time is short. We follow Cid. He's heading towards Giruvegan.", 'Not coming, Reddas? Forget your precious nethicite already?', "Ah, another lead, then, is it? You're well informed.", "I don't have an apprentice.", 'Venat.', "It appears Cid has yet to arrive. We'll lie in wait for him here.", 'Not unless you want to end up twisted. Like the old man.', 'Something there?', "And I should've realized by now.", "He's not coming. He laid out the bait, and we bit. Remember what he said? He wanted Ashe to get the Stone. He wanted that all along. That's why he flaunted his nethicite, and reeled us in with his stories about Giruvegan. All to bring Ashe to the Occuria.", "Maybe he wants to see what happens when foes with nethicite collide? That'd be just like Doctor Cid.", '"History is built by our hands." That\'s his favorite line. He\'d never stand by and watch the Occuria\'s Stones shape things. So ... he was talking to Venat all along. He wasn\'t mad at all then, was he.', "I'd rather stay out of that sky pirate's debt, thank you.", "You're an expert on pirating now, are you?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['...', "Look, uh, now isn't the best time, okay? Things are a little ... tense. If you need something, come back in a little while, once things have settled down.", 'And who was it told you that?', 'Does nothing get past that Dalan? He has ears in every wall. All right, get inside. But not a word of what you see or hear in there, you got that?', 'I overheard you and Bas - your friend - talking. Trying to find some transportation, eh? Well, with money or the right connections that would be easy enough. You might try looking up in the city for someone headed the same way as you.', "Sorry, but I can't let you back inside. Outsiders such as yourselves would only be in the way. You and Captain Ronsenburg would do well to keep from drawing any unwanted attention. Avoid using your real names and you should be safe enough. Few people are like to recognize you by your face alone."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["New member, are you? M' name's Bansat. I'm a hunter here in Clan Centurio. Pleased to meet ya.", 'Getting the feel for battle? You can never have too much practice.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Nabudis has fallen.', 'I know not. I am sorry.', 'I will go.', 'The fortress is lost! We must withdraw!', "Then it's over!", 'Lord Rasler!', 'You, there. Can you hear me?', 'Do not say that. Not all of us are here for love of battle. He fights to defend his homeland. Your name?', 'Good. Reks. You bore a few cuts, but you are still whole. Well, can you stand?', 'Think you can fight?', 'How old are you, Reks?', 'Young. Family?', "So young. You're barely old enough to be a man. You shouldn't be forced to wield a sword.", "I'm aware of the situation.", 'Vossler, go ahead! I will handle this rabble.', "Steady, Reks. Keep your wits about you and you'll make it.", 'We move!', "You must always be mindful of your surroundings. Use the right analog stick to look around. It's a useful way to spot Imperials. Go on, give it a try.", 'Use the left analog stick to move, Reks. Tilt it slightly to walk, and further to run. You can walk, yes? Come, stand before me.', "Do you see the marker above my head? That's a Talk Icon. You can talk to any character showing one of these. To talk to someone, approach them and press X. Try talking to your friend by the gate.", "We'll enter the fortress through this gate. We must go.", "We'll enter the fortress through this gate. We must go.", "See the marker above your head? That's called an Action Icon. One of these will appear when you approach a door, a switch, an item, or the like. To learn more about what you've found, walk closer and the icon will change. Then press X. Now, try opening the gate.", "It is time. We will drive back any Imperials standing between us and the King. Dalmasca's future hangs in the balance. Stay focused on the foes before you, Reks. I will watch rearward.", 'You can open the Party Menu by pressing triangle. From the Party Menu you can examine your equipment and inventory.', "That red line is a hostile target line. Take heed – you're being targeted. When a foe targets you, the line is red. When you target a foe, the line is blue. If you see a red line, look for foes at once. If they are not readily apparent, use the right analog stick to look around. When you've found them, press X to open the Battle Menu. Once you've selected Attack and targeted a foe, close distance using the left analog stick. You'll automatically attack until your foe is defeated. You can change targets or actions at any time. If your HP falls, press x and select Items from the Battle Menu, then use a potion. After using an item, you will automatically resume your previous action. There is no need to input your commands again. You can do it, Reks. Show me!", 'There is no simple way through the fortress – the Minimap at the top right of your screen may not be enough to gain your bearings. Should you lose your way, consult your Location Map by pressing Select. This will bring up the map of the fortress we gave you before we set out.', 'There is no simple way through the fortress – the Minimap at the top right of your screen may not be enough to gain your bearings. Should you lose your way, consult your Location Map by pressing the touch pad button. If you still find yourself at a loss, pressing the L3 button will allow you to view the Location Map as you move. Navigate your way through as you see fit.', 'Vossler. Where are you?', "Don't talk such nonsense! Vossler's laughed in the face of Death far too many times to stop now! Men like him don't die in places like this. We must make haste to reach the King. We will take him to safety.", "He'll agree to an unconditional surrender. They wouldn't dare touch him until the wax on his seal is dry.", 'Wait.', 'Quickly, Reks!', 'Ahead we will face many Imperials, but we need not fight them all. Oftimes retreat is the wiser course. Should the need arise, press and hold R2 to run from your foes. There is no shame in fleeing from a battle that serves no purpose.', "This is a save crystal, Reks. You can save your progress by approaching a save crystal and pressing X. Touching one of these crystals will also fully restore your HP and MP. Though you will gradually recover MP as you move about, it can take time. Do not miss this opportunity to refresh yourself and your allies. There is more I would tell you, but we've no time. Heed the lessons of the battlefield and you will do well. Come – we must reach His Majesty before it's too late!", 'Fight well.', 'To silence Ondore. How many times must I say it?', 'Why not ask Vayne himself? Is he not one of your masters?', 'Better than throwing it away.', "Who's there?", 'I did not kill him.', 'Please, get me out. For the sake of Dalmasca.', 'And you have it.', "I'm sorry.", 'I give you my word: that was not the way of it.', 'Of course not. It was my fault that Reks was there. I am sorry.', 'Not me then. Believe in your brother. He was a fine soldier. He fought to the last to protect his homeland. No. Surely he fought to protect his brother.', 'To think Dalmascan air could taste so sweet.', 'Yes, the hour of my return is already over late. The people may hate me, but that does not free me of my charge.', 'I thank you.', 'The Resistance will surely find me soon. Fates will we meet again. I would pay my respects to your brother.', 'Then will you fight again at my side?', "Just the opposite. Reks was the witness they needed. They had to make it appear as if I'd killed the King – Reks bears no blame. The Fates have willed it.", 'Do you not think Amalia worth saving?', 'Then what will you do? Hold me here in chains?', 'Some things never change. Do they.', 'Let them watch. I know something of cages.', 'Then you know her.', "Our paths keep crossing, yours and mine. It's more than coincidence.", "I'm sorry. Allow me one last annoyance: a favor to ask. I want you to take me to Balthier. Even caged birds need wings.", 'Even?', "I'm sorry. I didn't know.", 'I am sorry.', "I'll join you. I have some business there as well.", 'How flies Bhujerba?', 'If it becomes known that I am alive, the Marquis will lose their favor.', 'Of course.', 'What manner of errand?', 'Under Imperial guard, no doubt.', 'Our purposes lead the same way: to Ondore. We must find means to approach him.', 'Marquis Ondore announced my execution 2 years ago. If news of my survival were to spread, the Marquis may find his position compromised.', "Spread the rumor that I still live, and the Resistance here in Bhujerba will come out of their hiding places to ascertain the truth. If we can contact their organization, we can use them to get to the Marquis. We'll rescue Penelo from his estate, and see where he stands.", 'I should like nothing more. I would meet him, and see for myself.', 'And that is the only reason I draw breath.', 'A leader of the Resistance has fallen into Imperial hands. A woman by the name of Amalia. I would rescue her, but I need your help.', "Sorry. Can't be helped.", 'King Raminas entrusted me with a task. Should the time come, he bade me give you something of great importance. It is your birthright: the Dusk Shard. It will warrant the quality of her blood. Only I know where to find it.', 'If that is your duty: yes.', 'So you were carrying it all along. The Fates jest.', 'There was nothing else that I could do. You know that.', 'The Marquis has been busy.', 'You did your duty. And mine for me.', 'Of course.', 'Majesty. We will cut you a path.', 'Her Majesty cannot abide weakness, least of all in herself.', 'I do not forget, Majesty. It was by his counsel, dangerous though it may have been, that we were able to free you. You must meet with him, Your Highness, and give ear to his words. He may act in league with the Empire, but his heart is not.', "Kidnapping royalty is a serious offense. It won't do much to lower the bounty on your head.", "Allow me to escort you in Vossler's place.", 'Far to the west. We must first cross the Ogir Yensa Sandsea. We must pace ourselves. If you grow tired, we stop and take rest.', 'You are at that.', 'A construct to draw oil from the ground. Abandoned many years now, it seems.', 'No. The Rozarrians. Their empire lies far to the west, ever at war with Archadia. Heedless of the kingdoms caught in their midst. Dalmasca. Nabradia. Landis.', 'Vossler! Why are you here?', "Balthier is a man worthy of our trust, and it was the Lady Ashe's decision. I am content to lend my arm. As I could not when Rasler died, when her throne was taken. Never again. I will defend her this time.", "What's wrong?", 'Are you mad, Vossler?', 'I do know. All too well.', "I know you do. I would ne'er gainsay your loyalty.", 'An alliance between Dalmasca and the Empire?', 'A shame perhaps for me and for you. But for Dalmasca it is hope!', "After Vayne's ruse, I had abandoned hope for honor ... yet never did I forget my knightly vows. If I could protect but one person from war's horror ... then I would bear any shame. I would bear it proudly. I could not defend my home. What is shame to me?", 'There is hope.', 'Hope for a future where we can join hands as brothers.', 'So he was here.', 'This is all that remains of Nabudis. Two years ago it was destroyed utterly by a mysterious force. The work of the Midlight Shard.', "As the Dawn Shard brought down the Leviathan and her fleet, a fell Mist spilled forth. It is like the same thing happened here. The nethicite's Mist has corrupted the life of this place. It is a necrohol overrun with beasts. We tread here on a fool's errand. We had best turn back.", "Good, Vaan. You've come to understand the difficulties of serving royalty.", "Right. Let's get moving.", 'Right.', 'It would seem not, though this will make our task more difficult still.', "It's too quiet.", 'Something may be afoot. We proceed with caution.', 'And you are ... our earlier visitor.', "It's just what Vayne wants. He lures the Rozarrians and the Resistance to the field, then crushes both with the nethicite!", 'You are not troubled by the unknown? Who can say what lies ahead? We may encounter the very creators of nethicite.', "You're sounding more the sky pirate every day.", 'We could not see them, but we heard the Occuria speak. They may be gods, but we are the arbiters of our destiny. Your Highness, I am against this. The Empire must pay, but destruction?', "He should've arrived by now.", 'In tower on distant shore dreams the Sun-cryst.', 'Do these words mean aught to you?']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Don't think ye can look down on me. I'm savin' me gil to get out of here and up there. Why, I've got a bag full o' coin put aside already ... That is, I had a bag full o' coin, till someone came along and stole it! Grr ... I was sure it'd be safe as houses in that barrel, too ...", "Whaaat!? Yer tellin' me that ye know the bloke what's taken me coin!? Oh, it was him, was it?", "Hey, er, thanks mate. Got me bag o' coins back. I'm just preparin' meself for the journey up to the City, now. How about you? Are you prepared? Deep down? Really? Oh. All right, well, best o' luck then."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Can't pirate without good arms! We might not have much, but what we've got is a steal!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["What's your business here, boy? You don't look much like a hunter. Pah. This ain't no pleasure dome, boy. Keep faring, wayfarer.", "I hear you did a piece of hunting off in Sochen? The Huntmaster said you were ready for testing ... Eh? What kind of testing? Now that's for me to know, and for you to find out after you've taken care of your business in Archades. Later, boy.", 'Done what you needed to do in the capital, boy? The Huntmaster was saying he had some words for you.', 'Ah, being tested, are you? I did that some time ago, myself ... Ach, those were the days!', "So, you passed your test, boy. Suppose it falls to me to tell you what to do next! Now listen, this is what I want you to do. There're rare game out there that've mutated. They're a meaner bunch than the usual fare out there. Your usual marks, they get posted after damage has been done, but we want you to find these rare game before lives are lost, see? These rare game, they aren't going to make it easy for you. You have to find 'em and bring 'em down before you'll know they're rare for sure ... if they drop a trophy when they fall, congratulations, you've just found yourself rare game. Now, you bring them trophies back here when you get 'em. We won't pay you directly, as with usual marks, but there is a reward. See, if you bring in enough trophies, we'll put things out at the Outfitters for you to buy. Give them to me, and I'll stock up on protectives. ...You could give 'em to my brothers, too, but I don't see why you'd care to do that. So, what say you? Will you join the hunt? Say yes, and I'll send you on your way ... and you can turn the trophies in to whom you please. Of course, it pleases you to give them to me, right? Well? Are you ready?", "Right, then have at it, boy, and bring yer trophies back to me! You get lost, or aren't sure what to do, you talk to the Huntmaster. He's been at this since I was still crawling. He'll learn you right.", "That so? Suppose there's naught to be done about it then.", "Eh? If you have any questions, you talk to the Huntmaster. I'm just here for the trophies, see?", 'Done what you needed to do in the capital, boy? The Huntmaster was saying he had some words for you.', 'Ah, being tested, are you? He'll learn you right.", "That so? Suppose there's naught to be done about it then.", "Eh? If you have any questions, you talk to the Huntmaster. I'm just here for the trophies, see?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["It can get quite hot here in Giza, but it's not all that bad if you can find a nice spot in the shade. Take care before heading out to the plains. Our children don't leave without making the proper preparations. Neither should you.", "Don't go out to the plains unprepared. Speak with Arjie before you go if there's anything you need.", "You've a troubled look, child. What's the matter? Ah, come from Rabanastre seeking a sunstone, have you? As you might have guessed from the name, sunstones contain the power of the sun. You'll often find them used as a source of heat or light. Here we leave all things sunstone to Masyua. You should be able to find her near the dark crystal. Do you see the large black stone behind my tent? That is a dark crystal. You'll not be able to find them outside Giza Plains. The dark surfaces of the crystal drink in the light of the sun.", 'You need a sunstone, yes? Best speak with Masyua about that. She should be just behind my tent.', "I'm glad to see you were able to find a sunstone for yourself. Heading back to Rabanastre soon, then? Come visit us whenever you like. We will be here until the coming of the Rains.", "Giza Plains has two seasons, the Dry and the Rains. I don't smell rain on the air ... I'd say the Dry ought last a while longer. You look like you're getting swept up in something big, boy. See it doesn't sweep you away, eh?", "They tell me the fallen tree blocking the road to Kerwon was washed away by the Rains. The way south through Starfall Field is open. If you're heading that way, see you're well provisioned before setting out. Changes in the land mean changes in the beasts that walk them.", 'I was walking through the plains several days past when I was overcome by the feeling some great power had been lost. I pray it is no ill omen.', 'Whatever comes to the world beyond the plains, Giza will always be Giza. The sun, the earth, the winds ... if we have these, we have our home.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Everyone sure seems busy today. You, Kytes, Penelo ... Me? Don't worry, I've got my own work to keep me busy. Heh heh. I'm gonna be so rich that – I know! I'll be rich enough to buy an airship! You can ride it anytime you want, Vaan!", 'Hey, Vaan. I saw you and Penelo together during the parade. You sly dog ...', "Hey, Vaan. Where've you been? Feel like it's been forever since I saw you last. Hmm, haven't seen Penelo today, now that you mention it. She wasn't in Migelo's, either.", "Hey, Vaan? I heard ... I heard Penelo was kidnapped. It's not true ... is it?", "What's that? Penelo's with you? Phew! I guess all that talk about her bein' kidnapped was just talk. I was worried for nothin'.", "Hey, Vaan. I haven't seen you around town much lately. And now that I think of it, I haven't seen Penelo around, either ... So ... just what have you two been up to, huh? Heh heh heh.", "Hey, Vaan. You and Penelo off traveling on your honeymoon? Heh, I'm just teasin' ya. It's just I don't see you two much anymore is all. I know you've got stuff to do that's over my head, and that's okay. Just make sure you come back safe, all right? My mom and dad said they'd come back, but they never did ... I don't want that to happen again, okay?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Don' get many visitors down here. Come scavengin' fer odds and ends, have you? I don't reckon you saw whatever caused that terrible racket just now, eh? Hrm. Come crashin' down straight on the stairs? That was the only way out! Guess it's time to start lookin' fer a back door outta this place. What about you? You plan on pokin' 'round these tunnels, best go prepared. I piece together what scraps of this, that, and the other I find into all manner of things. It may be I have somethin' you need.", "Normally I get supplies I need off'n the caravans come through Nalbina. But Barheim Passage is known to have certain items not easily come by. I knew it weren't safe, but ... well, here I am.", "You wanna make it outta here alive, best go prepared. It may be I have somethin' you'd want to, uh, purchase, eh?", "Normally I get supplies I need off'n the caravans come through Nalbina. But Barheim Passage is known to have certain items not easily come by. I knew it weren't safe, but ... well, here I am.", "To smithereens, you say!? Then there's nothin' left but to find some other way out through these tunnels. You'll need to get the power workin' again, 'fore that gate'll budge, though. The fuse in that contraption up the stairs is blown ... but this oughta fix it up.", "Made that tube fuse from parts I found down in these very tunnels. It's good as any you'll find, and better 'an most, mark my words.", "Don' get many visitors down here. You come scavengin' fer odds and ends, have you? Oh, the way out? It's just back up those stairs -- To smithereens, you say!? Then there's nothin' left but to find some other way out through these tunnels. You'll need to get the power workin' again, 'fore that gate'll budge, though. The fuse in that contraption up the stairs is blown ... but this oughta fix it up.", "Made that tube fuse from parts I found down in these very tunnels. It's good as any you'll find, and better 'an most, mark my words.", "What's that? No power in the Passage, eh? Can't say I'm surprised, tunnels as old as these. This gate ain't workin' one, either. Here we go ... try putting this in that contraption up the stairs.", "Made that tube fuse from parts I found down in these very tunnels. It's good as any you'll find, and better 'an most, mark my words.", "Looks like that fuse did the trick, but that don't change the fact it's dangerous down here. There's anything you want to be buying, be about it.", "Normally I get supplies I need off'n the caravans come through Nalbina. But Barheim Passage is known to have certain items not easily come by. I knew it weren't safe, but ... well, here I am.", "I see you got the gate open. Oughta be able to look fer all manner of ways out, now. While the lights are on, the Passage ain't so bad. But let the charge drop, and some fierce beasts start comin' out in the dark. Openin' this gate probably took the charge down some. That gauge oughta show you how much charge is left. Hrm, 'bout thirty percent to operate somethin' the size of these gates, I'd say. Who knows how many more of these gates they got down here. You look fer these switchboards, you oughta be able to make yer way.", "Ain't life funny? When I ran into you down in the Barheim Passage, I'd never seen you before, and reckoned I'd never see you again..", "Now here we are! Well, you keep up yer scavengin' and I'll keep up mine, heh heh."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['– I was going this way!', "My brother! A message come from Rabanastre! The Strahl, she's set sail! She leaves straight for the Skycity of Bhujerba!", "A tender beatin' ... My specialty!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['S-Sir? Yes, sir!']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["I'm in charge of seeing all the herbs and roots we gather in the plain are properly dried and stored. We use charms made from the herbs to keep the monsters away while we're out. Used a whole lot during the Rains, so we need t' pick more!", "Those two must've gotten into a fight again, no doubt about it. That Jinn ... always getting into trouble!", 'Hmm ...', "Something's up, but Roaklo and Tott aren't talking. They don't have to, though. It's written all over their faces.", 'Hee hee!', "Guess what! I saw Jinn off in the south part of the plains – in the Crystal Glade. He was right by a small crystal. I asked if he wanted to come back to camp with me, but he said he still had some work to finish up. The Crystal Glade is to the south of our village. Just head out into Giza Plains and wind your way south. We take breaks in the glade, since monsters seem to stay away from it. I was a little worried because Jinn looked like he might have been hurt, but I was afraid to push him too hard to come back. Now I'm wondering if I did the right thing.", 'I saw Jinn in the Crystal Glade. We take breaks in the glade sometimes, since monsters seem to stay away from it. The Crystal Glade is to the south of our village. Just head out into Giza Plains and wind your way south.', "Can you believe it? Tott and Roaklo left Jinn to fend off that werewolf by himself! Those little – they're such ... cowards!", "Normally you can go down to Kerwon through Giza, but the Rains washed up a tree what's blockin' the path. Maybe the next Rains what come'll wash it away?", "The tree what was blockin' the path to Kerwon's finally gone. And it's a good thing, too. Lots of herbs we can't find no other place. Are you goin' to Ozmone Plain? I haven't been too far that way, but the monsters sure look tough.", "The charms we use to ward off monsters need carynath root, but I can't find any. I can't remember where I put anything these days. I thought I had everything in order, but if I don't find it soon, I'm gonna have to go out and collect some more."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Ladies and gentleman, allow me to welcome you aboard on behalf of the East Ivalice Company. Your captain for our voyage is Mr. Ranton, with Mr. Nicol his first officer. I am Chief Steward Chezelle. We have cabins available, should you wish to retire for the remainder of our journey. And please, let me know if I may be of any service.', 'Ladies and gentlemen, allow me to welcome you aboard on behalf of the East Ivalice Company. Your captain for our voyage is Mr. Erbna, with Mr. Ardinne his first officer. I am Chief Steward Chezelle. We have cabins available, should you wish to retire for the remainder of our journey. And please, let me know if I may be of any service.', 'Ladies and gentlemen, allow me to welcome you aboard on behalf of the East Ivalice Company. Your captain for our voyage is Mr. Erbna, with Mr. Ardinne his first officer. I am Chief Steward Chezelle. We have cabins available, should you wish to retire for the remainder of our journey. And please, let me know if I may be of any service.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["That viera bird won't stop starin'. She don't look very 'appy to me. Wonder wot's up wiv 'er? Nuffink serious, I 'ope. Mjrn, eh? Pretty name. Hmm ... I 'ate seein' a fellow bird so mis'rable. Maybe I can do summink to cheer 'er up a bit?", "Them sparkly pebbles ain't 'alf pretty, are they. Shame yer can't take 'em out the village. 'Ang about! 'Ow the 'eck do I know that? An' just 'ow many o' these blinkin' things do I need to fetch to cheer up Mjrn then, eh?", "Sparkle, sparkle ... I'm bloomin' sure I'm forgettin' summink ... now wot the 'eck was it? Ooh, I'd forget me bleedin' beak if it weren't screw'd on! I'm gonna go crackers tryin'a remember ...", "A sparkly pendant ... Now where've I 'eard that before ... ? ... Aw! I can't soddin' well remember! Mjrn ... love ... them sparkly pebbles ...", "As a matter o' fact, I 'ave! Ev'ryfink from start to finish! I was gath'rin' them sparkly pebbles, 'cos I thought as they'd make a nice pendant, see. Only trouble was, they'd vanish ev'ry time I tried to take em out the village. So I 'ad a bit of a think, an' I thought: wot if I got em out so fast, they wouldn't know they'd gone? An' that's when I made a break fer it ...", "An' now I'd betta be on me way. They'll be wond'rin' where I've got off to. Oh, an' that Terra girl's such a little darlin'... Wouldn't wanna worry 'er any more than I 'ave already. She can be a bit ... sensitive, see.", "Now don't go talkin' like that, girl. Yer a grown woman! Yer've gotta keep yer 'ead 'eld 'igh! 'Ow's about I give ya all them sparkly pebbles I found, eh? 'Ow'd ya like that?", "Now then, I really should get goin'. It's back to good ol' Giza fer this bird! Ta fer all yer 'elp wiv them pebbles, darlin'. I'd've never remembered Terra wivout 'em! Cheerio!", "When I come back, little Terra was cryin' 'er eyes out, poor love. I di'nt realize we'd given 'er such a fright. Won't be lettin' that 'appen again."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["We must see the real thing to be sure. Nabudis has taught us much! Yes, it's well hidden. They'll be off chasing after shadows, the fools. Ah, yes. The reins of History, back in the hands of Man.", 'Hah, Vayne! You seem to be enjoying your job as consul.', 'Hard at work as always, trying to find a dagger for your back.', "And you've come here to stop me? I'd fain see you try.", 'Pirate scum of the skies. What brings you here?', "You've come all this way for that trinket? I thought you above this.", "Hm? What's that?", 'The Princess of Dalmasca come to visit?', "She's not entirely without merit. A test of sorts for our princess?", "A trial for Ashelia B'nargin Dalmasca!", "You lust for the Stone's power, do you not?", "Venat, you shouldn't have.", "Ashelia B'nargin Dalmasca! Just how far will you go for power? Does your lust for nethicite consume you? Am I right? I am, aren't I. A worthy daughter of the Dynast-King! You would do well to go to Giruvegan. Who knows? You may receive a new Stone for your trouble.", 'The reins of History back in the hands of man. I too make for Giruvegan. Give chase, if you dare it!', 'That so sweet a child could be your brother is hard to believe.', "What's that, Venat? Ah, taken the bait already, have they? Splendid.", 'The Occuria have given the Princess her Treaty-Blade.', 'To hell with the Occuria and their stones!', 'What good a power that cannot be harnessed? Baubles best-suited for study, no more.', 'Oh, I am grateful for the sacrifice. Without it, manufactured nethicite would have eluded us — an unrivaled weapon, I warrant you.', 'Tell me, Venat. Have I not been an apt pupil?', 'Our lives are much too short. You undying might waste long centuries away, but we, I fear, cannot.', 'Your greatest work still lies before you. Not lightly will the Occuria allow you to wrest the reins of History from their grasp, back into the hands of Man.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Clio's Technicks ... How may I help you, kupo?", "The Captain, alive, kupo? Oh, I've heard some good ones in my day! That's not one of them, though. If it were true ... kupo ..."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["What are they doin' holdin' a parade? Nothing these Imperials do makes any sense to me ...", "The guards may be watchin' us, but I'm watchin' them. I don't trust 'em any further than I can throw 'em.", "The Empire dispatched a natural philosopher here to look into something or the other. He tried askin' me some questions, but I won't have any part in it. He's probably still over at Westgate trying to figure out what to do next.", "You want to know about the storm in the Westersand? Been talkin' to that philosopher from Archades, eh? Well, you seem all right ... Back when I was just a kid, I remember that storm growin' worse and worse. We had a way to make it inside, though. Now, if I could just remember ... You should go talk to my friend Northon, over by Storehouse 5 in Lowtown. We were always playing in those sandstorms when we were kids.", "We'd hide away in that sandstorm for hours at a time, but I don't remember how we got through. You should go talk to my friend Northon, over by Storehouse 5 in Lowtown.", "So, talk to Northon, did you? I guess you're serious about this. The windvane? Hmm ... You know, I think he may have hidden part of it in the dead end northwest of the Shimmering Horizons.", "It kept growing, and growing — we were terrified. And now that I think about it that's just about the time the sandstorms started getting worse.", "Hm? Is that ... is that a wind globe you've got there? That looks just like the one you used to have, Northon.", "Well, that's about it. I can't think of anything we might have left out.", "So, how did that whole storm business turn out? The windvane should get you through, no mistake. Who knows what it's like in there now ..."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Don't worry, they won't bite! These cockatrices are as tame as can be. Aren't they just the fluffiest, cutest things you've ever seen?", "Would you look at this ... All our cockatrices, gone! I'd always left the pen open, and they never tried to escape before. What do you think got into them? There's nothin' to do but head out lookin' for 'em, but I don't even know where to start. I can't blame Terra for this ... It's my fault. She wasn't ready for the responsibility.", "Would you look at this ... All our cockatrices, gone! I'd always left the pen open, and they never tried to escape before. What do you think got into them? There's nothin' to do but head out lookin' for 'em, but I don't even know where to start. I can't blame Terra for this ... It's my fault. She wasn't ready for the responsibility.", "I wasn't sure what we were going to do, but they're all back safe and sound now. In fact, they seem better than ever. Like they actually learned a thing or two on their travels. Of course, Terra's thrilled they're back, too."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Hi there. Name's Dantro. I'm on watch here. You come hoping to go to Nalbina? Sorry to tell ya, but the road's not open. Hey, don't blame me. You're not the only one put out by it, either. I've been waitin' forever for my replacement to come.", "Now that the ceremony for the new consul's over, they've finally opened up the road to the Nebra. The village still hasn't sent out my replacement, though. How long do they expect me to stand watch here, anyway?", "Even a small outpost like ours can mean the difference between life or death in the desert. We see quite an assortment of travelers through here. Keeps things interesting, at least. Not interesting enough for me to want to be here all day, though.
