Why hasn't the village sent out my replacement?", 'Running errands for my wife, eh? Nebralim? There should be some over by those crates. Help yourself.', "Those moogle's just got here from Rabanastre. You shoulda seen the three of them riding that chocobo. Wonder where they're headed. And I wonder what's keeping my replacement ... Did the village forget I'm out here?", "These travelers from Archades are a real handful. They were complaining the washtub is too small ... They should be grateful we have a washtub. Ah, well ... I'm ready to get back to the village and rest, but my replacement still hasn't gotten here. What's taking him so long?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["There's trouble on the north bank, I'm sure of it. I wish Dantro were here, but I know he can't leave the outpost unwatched.", "Shh! Quiet. We've a sick traveler sleeping just inside - collapsed not far from the village. I worry it may already be too late ... Dantro bade you bring this cactus flower? This should help, yes. Thank you. Take this for your trouble.", 'Keep your voice low, please. Our guest is still sleeping inside. The cactus flower you brought should help with the fever, but not the pain. If I had some semclam shells I could make something to ease the pain ... Do you think I could ask you to bring me some? Semclams live in the shallows along the banks of the river. The more you can bring me, the better.', "If I had some semclam shells I could make something to ease the traveler's pain. The more you can bring me, the better.", "You've brought the semclam shells! Yes, yes, this should do nicely. Unfortunately our guest's wounds continue to bleed. Nebralim can stanch the wound, but we seem to be out. I think Dantro took some with him when he left for the outpost. Would you mind bringing some back to the village?", "We'll need some nebralim if we're to stop the bleeding. I think Dantro took some with him when he left for the outpost. Fetch it, would you?", 'You have the nebralim! Wonderful! A little of this spread over the wound should stanch the bleeding. Now to do something about the poison ... Some valeblossom dew would quickly neutralize it ... I hate to ask for your help yet again, but do you think you could gather some for me? You should find some blooming along the cliffs in the Broken Sands.', 'Valeblossom dew contains a potent anti-toxin. You should find some blooming along the cliffs in the Broken Sands.', 'You found the Valeblossom dew? Wonderful! This should flush the poison from the body. Now we have only to wait, and hope.', "Is that ... is that a great serpentskin by any chance? Boiled and distilled it makes a potent restorative drought. It may speed our guest's recovery. This great serpentskin... would you give it to me?", "Thank you. I shall prepare the drought at once. I'm sure it will be of help.", "I see. A pity. But it is yours to do with as you will. I'm sure it will fetch a good price at market.", "You've helped me more than I could have hoped. The traveler rests now, and I expect a full recovery before long.", "Our guest is fully recovered now — should be just around back. Wanted to give you a word of thanks, if I'm not mistaken.", "I'm glad our traveler's recovered. Said some terrible things in the throes of that fever. Things I'd sooner forget.", "There's trouble on the north bank, I'm sure of it. I wish Dantro were here, but I know he can't leave the outpost unwatched.", 'What if he went with Tchigri?', 'He hunted the flowering cactoid for Dantro ... he must know how to defend himself.', "I don't understand. Why would The cactoids invade the village? They're usually harmless enough. Their son, you say? Then we must find him. But the desert is huge ... where would we even begin? Wait! If this cactoid's been causing as much trouble as they say, someone might've posted a bill for him! Unless - The bill Dantro posted ... you hunted that cactoid, didn't you? You don't think - Of course ... The cactoid you hunted must have been their son! Hunted and made into medicine ... We'll never be able to return him now! What? The flower? Why, I boiled it, and threw it away behind the house ...", "The cactoid you hunted must have been this son they're looking for. Made into medicine ... We'll never be able to return him now! What? The flower? Why, I boiled it, and threw it away behind the house ...", "What? The flower had budded into ... another cactoid? They're a strange lot, aren't they? Supposing you take it over to the north bank ... do you think they'd accept it as their son?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Desert our post? The Empire doesn't look kindly upon deserters, Gibbs!", 'You want to end up fighting on the front lines?', "A proper soldier never leaves his post until he's relieved. If that means staying until your dying day, so be it. More like you'll be shipped off to battle long before that, though.", "A soldier doesn't complain about his post, Gibbs. Granted it's hot ... the city reeks of sweat ... and I've sand in places sand has no right to be. And I'll never get the stink of chocobo out of my nose. That reminds me. The ones at Lord Vayne's appointment ceremony ... a gift of your family, weren't they?", "What's to be ashamed of? You ought to be proud. Your family raises some of the finest in the Empire.", "You there! This way's off limits. You'll have to turn back. Hm? What's the trouble there, Gibbs?", "You're not afraid of the chocobo, are you, Gibbs? Your family's held Tchita Downs for generations ... Surely you're used to them by now.", 'Blimey! (he runs after him) Blast! A member of the Imperial army running from a chocobo ... To your post, Gibbs! To your post!']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Still, people rarely visit the sandsea ... A bit of sand might make a nice souvenir?', 'Why have you come to such a place? You seem to be adventurers, yes ... Surely, you did not come to hunt treasure in the Valley of the Dead!', 'Well, adventurer, there may be more to you than I thought. With that, you may just be able to defeat the avion.', "Lo there, adventurer! If you're truly set ongoing to the Valley of the Dead, I'll give you some advice. The avian there is said to be invincible, but it has a weakness. I'm sure the Urutan-Yensa know something ... this Sandsea is theirs, you see.", 'It looks like some sort of tomb. The wealth it would take to build such a thing ... Think of the treasures it must hold!', "I'd have thought you lucky to 'scape that flying fiend's attentions with your life, but to best it!? That's more than luck!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["I'm terribly sorry, but there's been an emergency. No one is allowed to enter Central at this time. Please, come again.", "I see you've a sandalwood chop. Would you care to go to Central now, sir?", "I'm happy to say that the cockatrice has seen fit to depart, and we're once again up and running. Would you like to use the lift?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Oh? Unusual to see people out here ... We're trying to catch us some sandfish, but they're not biting.Dilah: Why have you come to such a place? You seem to be adventurers, yes ... Surely, you did not come to hunt treasure in the Valley of the Dead!Dyce: The Valley of the Dead? Treasure hunter or no, you'd best avoid that place. 'Less you care to tangle with an avion most fell! Speaking of which, you have all the equipment you need? The Yensan Sandsea's a vast place! If you need something, might be I can help you.", "Hail! You find your treasure? Heh ... no, there's little out there but shifting sand and hot sun ...", "What I want to know is, are you outfitted for the desert? I'm something of a merchant ... if there's anything you need, let me know!", "You still gallivanting about – Eh? You've claimed a treasure of the Urutan-Yensa!?Dilah: Well, adventurer, there may be more to you than I thought. With that, you may just be able to defeat the avion.Dyce: Say, if you do find some treasure in the Valley of the Dead, send some this way, eh? Ha ha ha! Now, care to buy anything?", "Oh? Unusual to see people out here ... We're trying to catch us some sandfish, but they're not biting.", "The Valley of the Dead? Treasure hunter or no, you'd best avoid that place. 'Less you care to tangle with an avion most dire ... What I want to know is, are you outfitted for the desert? I'm something of a merchant ... if there's anything you need, let me know!", "You still gallivanting about – Eh? You've claimed a treasure of the Urutan-Yensa!?", 'Say, if you do find some treasure in the Valley of the Dead, send some this way, eh? Ha ha ha! Now, care to buy anything?', "You still wandering these reaches? Time to give up treasure hunting, I'd say. The shining bird'll peck at your bones, boy ...", "You can't just go giving people fool advice like that! What if they actually went out and tried to do it!? That'd be blood on your hands. That said, if anyone knows the way through the Valley of the Dead, it's the Urutan-Yensa. But how to ask ... ? They don't speak our tongue. By the by, you need anything? Take a look at my wares! You might just be surprised at what you find ...", "You ... you killed the avion? Amazing! And this – I've never seen such a magnificent structure!", "And a hoard of ravenous monsters, I don't doubt. Me, I value life over loot. I go no farther ... But, should you find something, I'm sure I could be persuaded to part with a few gil for it! And if you need aught, of course, I'm your man!", "Hello there! Well, did you find your kingly treasure? It's good to see you again!", "Ah hah! True, true! Guess there's more to you than meets the eye, boy! Ah, a friendly word of advice: if you're going to the Cerobi Steppe, heed the weather! On days when it rains, the elementals come out to play, and take my word for it, there's little fun to be had in their games. Of course, you'll want to go prepared. Care to buy anything?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Rikken! Why must we aid these people? They seek only to further their own ends, and care little for our lord's wants, if at all!", "Measure!? You barely measure up to his waist, and that's counting the parrot.", 'Do as you please! But know that no good will come of this.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Greetin's, greetin's. More protectives for sale than you'd expect from a pirate shop."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Come to hear a tale, perhaps? There's a lot to be learned from the stories of the past ... a lot you youngsters seem to have forgotten. To your peril. You should show a little more respect ... for faerie tales.", "I was just telling these youngsters a story about the ruins in the Tchita Uplands. How many years I've spent in their study. How many more to come ..."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Filo's had us trainin' real hard. Bein' a sky pirate's a lot more work than I thought.", "Kytes loves helpin' ya out, Vaan. It's like the closer you are to a sky pirate, the closer he feels to being one too ... or something.", "Vaan, is that you? It's been so long I hardly reco'nized ya! Did something happen?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Arr, Vaan! Did ya go see the parade? Me? Are you kidding? Won't ever become a sky pirate watchin' parades. Gotta keep trainin'!", "Today we're trainin' to hunt treasure! I'm gonna hide, and you have to find me. I'll be somewhere down in the South Sprawl. Hop to it, mateys! Last one to find me's a buckethead!", "Arr, Vaan! Here to see Old Dalan? I'm just waitin' for my friends – er, mates – to show up. What's takin' them so long?", "Arr, Vaan! Welcome to the Buccaneer's Brigade! Come to tell us more stories about bein' sky pirates? This scurvy bunch would rather hear about bein' sky pirates than train for it. Maybe they need some trainin' on walkin' the plank ...", "Arr, Vaan! That door what Kytes could never open? He finally figured it out! He come lookin' for ya to let ya know, but since he couldn't find ya, he went back up to the storehouse to wait for ya there.", "Arr, Vaan! Haven't spied you 'round the city in a long time. Kytes and me were startin' to wonder what happened to ya! You seem the same as ever. You here to see Old Dalan? We're tryin' to solve a mystery. There was this suspicious guy – er, bloke – before. We wanna work out who it is."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Well then, I'll be taking that.", 'The gods do not smile on us.', "I don't know, it's not heeding me!", "What happened? Our hover didn't just drop – it disappeared.", 'Oh? Like a sky pirate that chooses to steal through the sewers?', 'Our ranks grow by the hour.', "I'm sorry.", "Have you finished? When the guards don't report in, they'll come looking for us.", 'A Judge.', 'The magicks binding the door to the oubliette are quite strong. Too strong even for my talents.', 'Look.', 'The Mist is flowing through this room. It must be going somewhere.', "I'm dropping it.", 'The Mist seethes.', 'We feel regret. We sought that stone and found ourselves only worry.', 'We stay in Rabanastre a while.', "She must worry for you. Balthier's handkerchief may dry her tears, but it cannot console her.", "It's Ba'Gamnan. He was in Nalbina.", 'The gods are toying with us.', "Balthier is waiting inside. If you've made ready, we can leave at once. He feels responsible for what has happened to your friend. Do not think he is in the habit of doing favors.", 'The shortest way is over Dorstonis.', "It would not seem they follow. We've lost them.", 'Do not worry. I believe he will treat her well.', 'Walk the streets of Bhujerba and speak of Basch where people have gathered. We will await you here.', 'Are you mad?', 'Not yet.', "Any faster and they'd have noticed.", 'Will you be joining us?', "Then it's settled. We should leave before the Marquis realizes she's missing. Like proper kidnappers.", 'We should leave this place.', 'Something far worse.', 'The wall comes. We must be quick! Together we can bring it down.', 'Not fog – Mist.', 'Where it is thick enough, you may. The nether runs deep in this place.', 'Yes, but it is also an aid. A dense Mist allows the workings of powerful magicks.', "In vainglory they arose, shouting challenges at the gods. But prevail they did not. Their doom it was to walk the Mist until Time's end. A legend of the nu mou.", "Such heat. The Mist – it's burning!", "The garif may know. The garif people live by the old ways. Magicite lore is a part of their culture. They may hear it. The cry of the nethicite's power. Whispers of the Stone's menace.", 'They live beyond Ozmone Plain.', 'The jungle denies us our passage.', 'We? No. I.', 'I am.', 'Our choices are few. This is as much for you as it is me.', 'You are ill at ease. The nethicite troubles you?', "You've let your eyes betray your heart.", 'Soon you will learn.', 'We go to seek aid of the viera who dwell ahead.', 'I am unwelcome. An unsought guest in their wood.', 'In the village ahead you will find her: Mjrn. Bring her to me. She will know why you call her.', "We will need Mjrn's help if we are to pass through the barriers of the Wood. She will know that I have come. Bring her to me. I will wait here for your return.", "I've heard the voice of the Wood. She says Mjrn is not in the village.", 'Jote. Where has she gone?', 'The viera may begin as part of the Wood, but it is not the only end we may choose.', 'Yes?', 'Your point?', 'I would avoid unnecessary ... confrontation. Do what you must, and let us be off. When you are ready, we should return to Ozmone Plain in the west. The Henne Mines are then only a short distance south.', 'Is it her? What is this Mist?', 'Mjrn!', 'We have seen this. On Leviathan, the Mist from the Dawn Shard drove me, too, into such a rage. She was taken not by the Dawn Shard.', 'Do not do this. You must remain away from the humes. Stay with the Wood. Live together with the Wood. This is your way.', 'I am no longer of you. I have discarded Wood and village. I won my freedom. Yet my past has been cut away forever. No longer can my ears hear the Green Word. This ... solitude, you want, Mjrn?', 'No, Mjrn. Only one sister remains to you now. You must forget my existence.', 'She goes against the laws of the Wood. I threw down these laws. It is better that I do this. Better I than one who must uphold these laws herself.', "I have a request: Listen to the Wood's voice for me. I fear - I fear She hates.", 'A pleasant lie, that.', 'I am as them, now. Am I not? Good-bye, sister.', "With Lente's Tear we can pass the barriers of Golmore Jungle. The Gran Kiltias on Bur-Omisace waits beyond. Our business here is done.", 'I would avoid unwanted confrontation. I shall wait for you here. My presence would only disquiet Mjrn. When I turned from the viera, I turned from my past. Too far is it now to turn back.', 'It has been roused. It fears the sword.', 'The stone is quiet.', 'There!', 'This Mist - he holds a Stone! It controls him as it did Mjrn!', "There is a hunter's camp just beyond the Salikawood. The camp sits within Archadia's borders, so Imperial patrols there should be sparse.", "He's had visitors. Ones lacking manners, by the looks of it.", 'His earlier visitors, more like. We should lie low for now.', 'Manufacted nethicite! Like Bergan.', 'The time given viera is long. Carefully must Mjrn consider her choice, for herself decide whether she will remain. She may choose the same path Jote walks, but it is her choice to make. Strength it takes to live by viera laws. Strength I may have lacked ...', 'The Mist runs thick here.', 'Do not worry. I will behave myself. The Mist here is cooled. I sense something like the shadow here.', 'I am fine. Thank you.', 'I wonder.', 'You could destroy all of Ivalice. If you wished it.', 'Will you take revenge, as they ask?']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Business has been slow these days. I've been looking for something new to sell – you know, try and turn things around. If I don't come up with something soon, I may have to close shop. I've no time to be worrying about parades and banquets.", "I'm at my wit's end. If that shipment doesn't get through ... I don't know what I'll do. There has to be a hunter out there who'll do it ..."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Of-Of course not! But our commanders did go down with the others in jagd. If we don't receive new orders, we're like to stand watch here till our armor rusts! I thought we might find a way to transfer to a new division.", "N-No sir! Only, it's so ... boring here.", "Fair enough, sir, but why'd it have to be here? Here of all places?", "I'd hope to forget. The fewer what know about that, the better."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["It's Balthier, my brother.", '– Bwagi, that way!']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Doctor Cid does this at Draklor?', "The long, cold years have clouded my eyes. I cannot see my own son's heart.", 'This illness will claim me. So then, who is to be my successor? The Senate fears the capable peregrine Vayne. They prefer a young, fledgling emperor.', 'Gabranth. Once in the past, I laid siege to your homeland.', 'Perhaps, but what of your brother? He did not accept us as you did. He fled to Dalmasca. Did you never think to follow him?', 'So you would kill even your own brother for the Empire. Be that as it may, Gabranth. Your ruthlessness is not without merit. But it must not become this way with Larsa. You must ensure that it does not.', 'Rather be his shield. Gabranth, keep your close watch on Vayne. His is the keenest blade of all.', 'Do this for me, Gabranth. I could not – I could not bear ... to see my sons war with each other again.', 'A convenient thing, justice. And so I must now make a choice ... between my throne, and my son.', 'Larsa so adores his brother, and he is yet young.', 'Ah, yes ... And who would set him at such tasks?', 'By your will. I shall bid Vayne return to Archades.', 'Necessity? Ah yes, necessity. Does that word free you, I wonder? You show no hesitation to solve matters with blood.', 'Is this your idea of vengeance?', 'So you would dirty your hands, to keep his clean?', 'So they are. And so House Solidor lives on.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["I heard from the War-chief. You ride for free! The offer's only good once, though. Well, care for a ride?", "Er, actually, I've never seen that Chocobo before in my life, kupo ... But I'll take a gil for it!", 'Welcome to the chocobo stables. Only "n" gil should you wish to hire one, kupo!', 'Perhaps another day, kupo. Should you ever need a chocobo, you know where to find one!', 'Well, hello there! You are no stranger to the yellow birds just behind me, I\'m sure. Yes, my friend, I speak of the chocobos, kupo! These noble birds make for excellent steeds. Fleet of foot and sturdy of limb, arduous journeys fly by atop a chocobo, kupo! Only "n" gil should you wish to hire one.', "What's that? You've not ridden a chocobo? Not to worry! Just be mindful that you've a limited amount of time for your ride, kupo! Off you go now! Quite a treat, watching the world fly by from your perch in the saddle, kupo!", 'Perhaps another day, kupo. Should you ever need a chocobo, you know where to find one!', "This guy is a black bangaa constantly chatting with a seeq at the East End of Rabanastre, right outside Migelo's. He's almost always expressing disbelief at his friend the seeq's estimate of how many cobblestones are in the Southern Plaza -- until they start counting bards."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Ah, you are the hume the War-chief has spoken of. You have crossed the plains to learn of the Stones, yes? I believe the elders can tell you much.', 'So the hume-child who came here was your companion. This is why he came to ask the same thing, I see now.', 'Our War-chief is a great warrior, though not so great as his older brother, who served as War-chief before him. Like a demon-god in battle he was.', 'our War-Chief is a great warrior, though not so great as his older brother, who served as War-Chief before him. Like a demon-god in battle he was.', 'Our War-chief speaks little and smiles less, but he is a kind person. He is stubborn, yes, but all in the village know of his prowess.Yet, to watch him now, it is sadness. He is in pain, unable to forget a past mistake.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["We have heard the whisper of the Wood. It tells us to deny passage to the humes. So have we summoned the barriers in Golmore. Those to whom Jote gives her leave, who bear Lente's Tear, may pass - no other.", 'Mjrn went against the Green Word. The decision to welcome her back has met with much discord. These foreign winds bring much trouble for us. You may rest here if you like, but do not interfere with the doings of the village.', 'We choose this hidden place, secluded from the world beyond, to live as we have always lived. This is what it is to be viera. If you understand our ways even a little, you will not set foot again within our village.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['He would sooner pass for the King.', "If at trickery it ended, it would end well enough. But why this boy, and why Captain Ronsenburg? An explanation is due, and I will hear it. The Empire's hounds grow passing bold indeed.", 'Wait!', 'So Basch fon Ronsenburg does yet live.', "I knew there must be more to it, but to find you at the end of this tale ... Ah, to see the Marquis's face when he learns of it.", 'How say you, my lord?']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Welcome to the Moogling, kupo.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Beyond here lies the hill where sits the Great-chief. Those from the outside are not welcome here.', 'If the War-chief has given you his trust, so shall I. Go, meet with the Great-chief.', 'The Great-chief is across this bridge. Walk softly.', 'The Great-chief is across this bridge. Walk softly.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Welcome to the Moogling, kupo. This is your first time using the Moogling? Nothing to it! The Moogling lets you teleport to several select locations across Rabanastre. We had to close for the parade earlier, but we're up and running again, kupo! The service is free of charge. Why not give it a try? There's no time like the present, kupo!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Many are the fiends that lurk in the crags of Paramina, but of them, the elementals, appearing during heavy snows, are the most dangerous.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Relj, do not say such things. If you find humes weak, then lend us your strength! Bereft of His Grace Anastasis's protection, Mt. Bur-Omisace is vulnerable. Even now, a terrible wyrm rages near. Many have fallen ..."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['With the passing of His Grace Anastasis, the future of the Kiltias is shrouded in darkness. I pray the Light will cut through these clouds ...']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Most of us out here work at makin' sunstones or raisin' cockatrices. We won't get much work done once the Rains come. Gotta make the best of the Dry now!", "Yeah, my name's Jinn ... What's it to ya? Masyua wants me to come back to the village, huh? Hmm, that could be a problem. Let's see ... maybe my leg's better now. Nope, no good – still hurts. I tripped running from some monsters ... guess I pulled something. I'm never gonna get any sunstones made like this. I just needed to make one more to be finished for today. I didn't want to head back short, so I thought I'd give my leg a rest and try again. Why are you out here looking for me, anyhow?", "So you need a sunstone, huh? Well, if Masyua doesn't mind, I'll give you a shadestone. But I'm still not sure I can walk yet – you'll have to turn it into a sunstone, okay? Don't worry, I'll tell you how. You do know that we use dark crystals and shadestones to make sunstones, right?", "There's your shadestone. As for the dark crystals, you'll find them all over Giza Plains. This stone right here beside me is one of the smaller ones. The bigger crystals have something inside that soaks up sunlight and shines really bright.", 'See that one over there? If you take that shadestone I just gave you and bring it near one of those shining dark crystals, it will absorb the energy from it.', "There are four shining dark crystals in Giza right now. If you have trouble finding 'em, just stop and scan the horizon. There's no way to tell how much energy you can draw from any one crystal without trying. You shouldn't need to use all four, though.", "This gauge will show you how much energy the shadestone's absorbed. When it's full, you'll have yourself a sunstone! Once you've made the sunstone, bring it to me. I'll make sure it's up to snuff. I'll go ahead and mark the dark crystals on your map, too. See you back here when you're done!", "If I go back without all my sunstones, everyone's going to make fun of me. But this leg won't be getting better in a hurry ...", "I know, I know. They want me to go back to the village. But I'm not heading back until I'm done here. And my leg still hurts, besides. How come you're so interested?", "So you need a sunstone, huh? Well, if Masyua doesn't mind, I'll give you a shadestone. But I'm still not sure I can walk yet – you'll have to turn it into a sunstone, okay? Don't worry, I'll tell you how. You do know that we use dark crystals and shadestones to make sunstones, right?", "There's your shadestone. As for the dark crystals, you'll find them all over Giza Plains. This stone right here beside me is one of the smaller ones. The bigger crystals having something inside that soaks up sunlight and shines really bright.", 'See that one over there? If you take that shadestone I just gave you and bring it near one of those shining dark crystals, it will absorb the energy from it.', "There are four shining dark crystals in Giza right now. If you have trouble finding 'em, just stop and scan the horizon. There's no way to tell how much energy you can draw from any one crystal without trying. You shouldn't need to use all four, though.", "This gauge will show you how much energy the shadestone's absorbed. When it's full, you'll have yourself a sunstone! Once you've made the sunstone, bring it to me. I'll make sure it's up to snuff. I'll go ahead and mark the dark crystals on your map, too. See you back here when you're done!", "If I go back without all my sunstones, everyone's going to make fun of me. But this leg won't be getting better in a hurry ...", "Be careful about wandering too far south. There are werewolves down there, and you don't wanna mess with them. That's how – Well, it's a long story. The important thing is that you remember how to make the sunstone. Take the shadestone I gave you and put it near the shining crystals. As soon as the energy gauge is full, the sunstone'll be ready! I already marked down all the dark crystals on your map. When you've made the sunstone, bring it here and I'll take a look at it.", "As soon as the gauge is full, the sunstone'll be ready! I'll be waiting right here for ya. And watch out for those werewolves to the south!", "Hey, you've got a sunstone! Let's take a look. Hmm, seems okay to me. Not bad for city folk. So here's what happened. Masyua's always warning us to stay away from the werewolves, right? Well, a bunch of us decided we'd have a little contest – see who's the bravest. It started out as a lark, but Tott said that none of us kids living on the plains should be scared of monsters ... I guess I got carried away. Don't let any of the grown-ups know, though, okay?", "Anyway ... my leg's feeling better now. Let's head back to the village. I'll race ya – try and keep up!", "I expected Masyua to get a little upset, but it seems like I really worried her. She was even madder than I thought she'd be. She just stood there, all quiet. Really had me scared! Heh.", "I like goin' out into the plains. That's why I never really think of makin' sunstones as work. Well, I like the plains in the Dry, anyways. The monsters that come out during the Rains are too scary.", "Hey, been a long time, huh? It's me, Jinn, from Giza Plains. Remember? It's the Rains now, so we've all left the village. Not a soul left there. I thought I saw some people coming up from Ozmone Plain when we was leavin' ... I wonder if they know the village is empty?", "I saw 'em bringing a bunch of hurt Imperials to Rabanastre. I thought the war was supposed to be over? My family was killed in the war ... But Brunoa brought me to live here. I don't wanna see anyone else get hurt.", "You ever been to Giza during the Rains? I hear huuuge frogs and turtles come out! I wanna be a natural philosopher when I grow up. I told Brunoa I wanted to go study in Archades, but she just laughed. Wonder what's so funny?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Oh, Vaan, how ya doin\'? Lots of people out today. Thought I may try out some of those "tricks" you showed me, heh heh.', "This new, uh, consul ... He's one of the ones that attacked Dalmasca, isn't he? Why'd it have to be someone like him ... ?", "I was, uh, practicing what you showed me, but I kinda slipped up and bumped into this viera ... in a bad sorta way. She didn't get mad or anything, just kept walking like nothin' happened. The man she was with didn't seem too happy about it, though.", "Ain't got nothin' to do. Ever since the parade, there aren't hardly any people visiting the city. A pickpocket's no good without pockets to pick!", "With you being gone so much lately, I think Kytes is really missin' you. You're like a big brother to him."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['It is not allowed for humes to walk on these grounds.', 'If you can find her.', 'Why do you ask? The Wood tells us where she has gone. Or ... can you not hear Her?', 'You cannot. Your ears are dull from hearing their harsh speech, I think. Viera who have abandoned the Wood are viera no longer. Mjrn, too, has left Her embrace.', 'It is the will of the village. Viera must live always with the Wood. So is the Green Word, and so is our law.', 'Our sister has left the Wood and gone west. She wanders warrens among men who hide themselves in clothes of cold iron. Thus to me has the Wood spoken.', 'The same words I heard 50 years ago.', "I heard the Wood's whispers. Take it.", "Lente's Tear is a permission. Pass through the Wood and leave. To other places go.", 'Ivalice is for the humes. The Wood alone is for us.', 'I am sorry to make you do this.', 'The Wood longs for you. For the child gone from under Her boughs.', 'Be cautious. The Wood is jealous of the humes who have taken you.', 'Mjrn is yet in her spring. Trouble her no more. She would shake and scatter before the rough winds that blow beyond the Wood.', 'Seed is carried furthest on rough winds. Where it lands matter little, so long as it finds fertile soil in which to take root.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["I-I'm a new recruit here, so I gotta work hard, or, or else they won't (snort) feed me! Bu hweeeeeeee!", "(snort squeal sniff) M-my hero, he's g-gone ... Bu hweeeeeeeee!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['The Senate may play at intrigue, but Lord Vayne will not be brought down easily. The entire military waits upon his orders, from the War Council to the rank and file. What better blade than he to strike down the enemies of the Empire?', 'I will not hear you malign Judge Zecht! He was a noble warrior. Or ... do you think his trust in Lord Vayne ill-placed?', 'Ruthless, you say? Would he were more so! He gives traitors no quarter, be they of his own blood! How fitting for one who would bear the burden of Empire.', 'A viper with many tails. Much of the Senate is culpable.', 'Vayne did not make himself autocrat. It was the very Ministry of Law which you serve. Do you see it now, Drace? When you bared your sword at His Excellency, you bared your sword at the law.', "The Empire's debts grow legion.", 'Ah, our vagrant princess. Swift has your lust for revenge led you to the Sword of Kings.', 'You will surrender it to me. Too late, and to their sorrow do those who misplace their trust in gods learn their fate.', "No. No, the power of manufacted nethicite is the power of Man! A weapon forged by his wisdom ... who would challenge the gods themselves! A fitting blade for a true Dynast-King. Raithwall did but pretend the title ... A cur begging nethicite scraps from his master's table.", "Hark! Ivalice hails her true Dynast-King, Vayne Solidor! He shall defy the will of the gods, and see the reins of History back in the hands of Man! His time is nigh! The new Ivalice holds no place for the name Dalmasca. The stain of Raithwall's blood ... shall be washed clean from history's weave!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Your Honor reminds me of Zecht two years since. He, too, put his trust in Lord Vayne's strength, and what became of him? Gone without a trace since Nabudis!", "Vayne took two of his own brothers' lives. He is ruthless beyond contempt.", 'But could we bear him?', 'Zargabaath, what of you? Surely you do not believe his brothers were traitors.', 'Lord Larsa has left for Bur-Omisace. He hopes to enlist the aid of the Gran Kiltias in stopping the insurgents. I doubt this will be enough to deter Ondore ... but even a slight hindrance to his operations would be welcome. This will delay the Rozarrian invasion ... and we will have bought much-needed time to shore up our defenses.', "No matter the result, I am pleased with the young Lord's progress. I can already see the stunned faces of those mud-witted senators. The fools think a child emperor's strings easy to pull from the shadows ... but they will find that Lord Larsa is no puppet.", "You're right. I shall speak on this matter with His Excellency at once. Gabranth. It falls to us to protect Lord Larsa. Are we agreed?", 'A viper amongst our Senators!?', 'Spare me your lies! I see the serpent coiled here before me!', "Zargabaath! Do not tell me you join in this mummer's farce!", 'Surely you would not go so far!', 'Vayne Solidor! As Judge Magister and upholder of the law, I hereby place you under arrest!', "You wear the mummer's motley well, Bergan.", 'Such strength - inhuman!', 'Do it. I care not.', 'Live, Gabranth. Protect the young lord. Protect Larsa ...', 'Pray be quick.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['The King intended all along to sell Dalmasca to the Empire. His Majesty was a traitor.', "We'll never surrender to you! We are not cattle to be sold by a traitor-king!", 'We will never bow to you!', "That's enough, Ba'Gamnan.", 'The Emperor is willing to overlook race for his more talented servants. However, those that do not show respect will receive none in kind. You travel freely through our lands because the Emperor wills it. Am I correct?', 'Where is the Captain?', 'This does not concern you, bounty hunter.', 'You have grown very thin, Basch. Less than a shadow. Less than a man. Sentenced to death and yet you live. Why?', 'Is that all?', "We've caught a leader of the insurgence. She is being brought from Rabanastre. The woman Amalia. Who could that be? Such a faithful hound to cling to a fallen kingdom.", 'Throwing it away? As you threw away our homeland?', 'The insurgents in Rabanastre operate alone at present. However, should they garner external support, the situation could worsen. We have found the counter-Imperial elements in Bhujerba to be conspicuously well-funded. No doubt Marquis Ondore is behind this. Ondore must be reined in.', 'He will die by my hand.', 'I have confirmed he receives funds from Lord Vayne. His agency in the fall of Nabudis is also certain ... yet, with Judge Zecht, who led the assault, missing ... the truth remains difficult to ascertain.', 'My Lord.', 'The Republic of Landis is long since gone. My allegiance lies wholly with the Empire.', 'I follow his every move. He is an enemy of the Empire. He will be cut down.', 'So then, you ask me to be his sword, to strike where he might not?', 'My Lord.', 'Your Honors, a summons! Lord Vayne has arrived at the palace.', 'Just as His Excellency had hoped.', "Yes. The senators would be most pleased with a puppet for an emperor. Recall, Drace, how the Senate fears and despises Lord Vayne's ability? When they realize the truth, that Lord Larsa is no docile lamb to be shepherded ... they will bare their teeth and devour him.", 'Aye.', 'Your Excellency, Lord Larsa was placed under my charge.', 'Forgive me.', 'And should I espy war, I am to put her to the sword. Is that your wish, Excellency?', 'As you will.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['You wear your saddle well.', 'Then you prefer the whip? Stubbornness will see not only you broken, Excellency, but Bhujerba as well.', "I see you've been out walking without the company of your cortege ... Lord Larsa.", 'We caught her wandering out of the mines. You must take care with such undesirables about.', 'Silence!', 'That was unexpected.', "Come now, come now. Have you forgotten your manners? This is hardly the courtesy due ... the late Princess Ashelia B'nargin Dalmasca.", 'To be sure, she bears no proof of her former station. No different than any mean member of the insurgence.', 'The Consul asks the ministry of the disthroned royal family in restoring peace to Dalmasca. Those who foster instability and unrest, who claim royal blood without proof ... they shall meet their fate at the gallows. There are no exceptions.', "Well, well. Splendid! You've brought the Stone with you! This spares us a great deal of trouble.", "A Judge's duty is to the law. Take them away. Lady Ashe is to be quartered separately.", 'Vayne Solidor. What fascination does this hold for you?', 'Such a great shame. I must confess: I thought you the one who would help us restore peace to Dalmasca. No matter. We hold the proof of your royal lineage. A maid of passing resemblance will serve our purposes now. As for you, my dear ...', 'The Empire requires you no more.', 'Your Majesty does not disappoint! Ever quick to spurn an honorable surrender, as was your father.', 'Such a tremendous honor to again be graced with your presence, Majesty. You left us with such great dispatch upon our last encounter that I must confess ... I had begun to worry that we may have given some cause for offense.', 'I want you to give me the nethicite.', "That is a base imitation! We seek Raithwall's legacy ... the ancient relics of the Dynast-King: deifacted nethicite.", 'Did you not tell them, Captain Azelas?', "Captain Azelas has struck a wise bargain. In return for the Dawn Shard the Empire will permit Lady Ashe to reclaim her throne, and the Kingdom of Dalmasca will be restored. Think on it. An entire kingdom for a stone. You must admit, 'tis more than a fair exchange.", 'Lady Ashe, let us take him for the people of Dalmasca. Your Majesty wallows in indecision on peril of their heads!', 'And his shall be the first to fall.', 'To think the relics of the Dynast-King were deifacted nethicite. Doctor Cid will be beside himself.', 'Captain Azelas, take them to Shiva. They should have leave to return to Rabanastre soon.', 'I want you to assess its power.', 'I will not chance returning with a Stone that is yet unproven.', 'Methods do not interest me. Only results.', "We've found it at last: true deifacted nethicite. The power of the Dynast-King in my hands. Blood alone does not an emperor make, Vayne.", 'What is it?', "I want to know what's happened!", 'Disengage it at once!']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Do not fear, I bear you no enmity. I am Judge Hausen, guard to Lord Larsa. I would accompany my lord to Mt. Bur-Omisace, yet I fear my presence upon the holy mountain would ... excite the followers of the Light. I entrust Lord Larsa to your care. Please, take this. It may help you along your way.', 'Normally I would accompany Lord Larsa to Mt. Bur-Omisace, yet I fear my presence would threaten the peace. I entrust Lord Larsa to your care. Please, be safe.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Might a boy be in the market for some ... information? Sorry, I've none worth selling. Such a boy would be wise to pass on anything he heard to me, though ... I'll pay a good price for word of goings-on in the Ministry of Law and the Senate. A boy could stand to make a profit ...", "Well, well, well ... there's a sight for sore eyes. Didn't think I'd be seeing you again. Not here.", "A pirate would do well to smile. Wouldn't want to sour his reputation.", "Sometimes an ear with tight purse strings's the order of the day. Like when a pirate decides he fancies going up in the world.", "In Archades, knowledge is power. And power has a way of opening doors, boy. Now, a fool will buy a sack of feathers for his pillow, but a wise man ... He'll buy the whole stinking cockatrice and get his fill of meat into the bargain. So, wise man, how does 1500 gil sound?", 'Bright boy. You learn fast. I call this meeting to order. Tell me, boy, heard any rumors in town?', "Bags in barrels, eh ... ? A boy would do well to bring that morsel to a man named Beasley near here. Tell him what you've heard.", 'You would do well to learn the ways of the world, boy, lest the world have its way with you.', 'So, wise man, how does 1500 gil sound?', 'Bright boy. You learn fast. I call this meeting to order. Tell me, boy, heard any rumors in town?', "Bags in barrels, eh ... ? A boy would do well to bring that morsel to a man named Beasley near here. Tell him what you've heard.", 'You would do well to learn the ways of the world, boy, lest the world have its way with you.', 'Boy. There\'s a man near here who goes by the name of "Beasley." Tell him what you just learned.', 'You told him just as I told you? Good boy!', "Oh? Witness the power of knowledge, m'boy. See? It begins.", "A pirate should know that words are worth gil uncountable. Here's some words for you: The prodigal Bunansa son's come back to the Imperial roost. See? Words of much value, these.", 'Having a spot of trouble, are we?', "I've a message from Master Balthier. He's waiting in Central. He says to come quickly.", "When a boy wants information ... that's right ... A boy pays. 2500 gil sounds about right.", "Why, any upstanding citizen of the Empire carries a chop. It's a mark of status sometimes, a writ of transit others. If you were aiming to go to Central, where the gentry live, I'd think you'd need 3 chops.", "Like I've said, the key is knowledge, boy. You do your part here on the street, talk to the right people, you'll earn your chops in no time.", "Oh, people in Archades love doing good deeds. Why, if they're helping you out, it must mean they're superior. Understand, boy?", "A bit late in the game to be pinching gil, isn't it?", "Tsk, tsk. A squad of Judges has been sent to Draklor. You'll find the service entrance rather a difficult proposition, I'm afraid.", "The Ministry? Oh, Judges make poor customers, my friend. Too many rules, too many laws. Perhaps you didn't know, Master Balthier, that Draklor is a toy box these days, filled with your lord father's conceits ... All developed without the Senate's knowledge, of course. Why, not even the Emperor knew the full extent of Dr. Cid's operations. Now, here's the catch: since Vayne had himself declared dictator, nary a peep has come out of that laboratory. I know people who would sell their own mum for the merest scrap of information about the goings-on inside Draklor.", 'And in exchange for your service, I\'ve spoken to a cabbie. When he asks where you want to go, tell him: "You know where to go." Simple, no?', 'Good to be back, eh? My regards to your lord father, Master Ffamran ... er, rather, Master "Balthier." Anon, anon.', "With your help, I've made myself a pretty bit o' coin of late. Many thanks, boy. Hope to do business with you again soon. Heh heh."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Finest what? Sorry to say I couldn't attend the appointment ceremony ... This place does stick, and no mistake. Better finish my work here and be off. Can't go back to Archades smelling like this.", "I'm working, in case you hadn't noticed. And the sooner I finish, the sooner I can be out of this chocobo fetor and back home in Archades.", "Tchita Downs, eh? Thanks to you, I've got what I need. And far sooner than I'd hoped! I'm an Archades streetear, see. That soldier's wife hired me to find out about his family. He'd always been very secretive about his past, and she was rightly concerned. Well, my work here is done. Back to Archades to collect my fee. It's a big city, but who can say ... perhaps I'll see you there someday. Farewell. And thank you!", "Shh! Don't talk to me!", "You ... I met you in Nalbina, did I not? Don't you remember me? I'm July, the streetear. Why, thanks to you, I've received a fine reward from the wife of an Imperial particularly unfond of chocobos. In fact, I owe you my gratitude. Here.", "So long, then. Hmm? What am I doing now? I work for an inquiry agency, as a matter of fact. The coin is good, but it's wearisome work, really.", "Once I've finished this posting, I'm off to make some inquiries in Rabanastre. A man here — an Imperial, actually — had his coin pouch stolen by a pickpocket in the market there, and he wants it back. Good luck, eh? So long!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Ah, you are the humes our War-chief saw on the plains. Welcome to our village, protected by the clear flow of the Sogoht. I am Supinelu's brother, Kadalu. I worry ... for Supinelu often goes to the plains alone. Why, when the others surely wish to train with him? He is stubborn this way. Your pardon. I spoke of a personal matter. Please forget it. You have business with the elders, yes? On you go.", 'Kerwon, by its very nature, does not welcome Man. Your journey, I fear, will be fraught with difficulty. I pray for your good fortune.', 'I believe my brother — he is the War-chief — wears his responsibility too heavily. He thinks he must do all himself. Yet there is not one of us who is all-powerful. Thus we rely on our companions to make up for our shortcomings. If only he could see this ...', 'I believe my brother — he is the War-Chief — wears his responsibility too heavily. He thinks he must do it all himself. Yet there is not one of us who is all-powerful. Thus we rely on our companions to make up for our shortcomings. If only he could see this...']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['I know where my brother has gone, bhadra ... But I cannot tell you. He would be very cross.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['The wood-warders gather about this cove. Mjrn is no wood-warder. You will not find her here. Do you come to visit misfortune upon us? You may expect no mercy if you do.', 'You come with traitors who abandon the Wood ... The blades of the wood-warders are sharp. Stay, if you would learn this for yourself.', 'Jote does not show favor to the sisters who share her blood. She is strict, yes. More so with her sisters, still more again with herself.', "Yes? What is it? We discuss our sentinel of the Wood. I do not share Rael's tolerance for your interruptions. If your errand concerns not me, speak with me not."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["We barely escaped with our lives. If we hadn't been away from the temple when they attacked ... The Empire will answer for this."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Yes? What is it you need? I am Krjn, a hunter of Clan Centurio. To know my boundaries did I join the clan. It is a wellspring of information about powerful marks.', 'If you sense danger, be cautious. Flight, too, has its place in battle.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['H-Hello. I am called Ktjn. I left my home and came to Rabanastre only quite recently. I have yet to learn my way around. I had been hoping to find someone I might speak with. Should you like to talk again, it would please me greatly.', 'Is the city not wonderful? I still lose my way on occasion, but I have come to know some of her walks and alleyways. But the land, I cannot hear it ... Should this not trouble me as a viera?', 'I see. Then perhaps it was a mistake to leave the Wood ... Pay no mind to my mutterings. Pray, speak with me again soon.', "I sometimes lose my way, but for the most part, I can find what I must. Not that I've any place to be, particularly ...", 'It is good to see you again. I have had so little opportunity to speak with humes. My people keep to themselves. The number of visitors to our village could be counted out on a single hand. So did I long to come to a great city such as Rabanastre. That wish is now come true, but this is not how I had hoped it would be. I knew my choice would bring hardship, yet ...', 'Perhaps I should have. Strength of will alone could not make up for my ignorance of the wider world. I do not wish to admit it, but I know it now to be true ... Feel not sorrowful. It is no easy thing to speak unwelcome truths to another. Yet these are the most valuable truths to hear.', 'I left the Wood to learn the ways of the world beyond. But nothing here is as it seems ... Perhaps I will begin to understand in time.', 'Hello. Have you come for another visit? Little has changed for me. I have seen much of the city, though I still have made few friends, and am no closer to realizing my goal. I have not spoken of this to you before, but I came to Rabanastre to become ... more like my sister. She had grown tired of our life of isolation ... Long ago she left. Only later did I hear rumors she had come here. All this time my sister has been making her way through the world, while I lived in the sheltered peace of the Wood. I would be as she is. Do you think it possible?', "... I see. So you think me too naïve to follow in my sister's footsteps. Though you may speak the truth, I am not yet beaten.", "I followed my sister's example and left the Wood, but it has not been an easy path for me to walk. I have much to think on ..."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Vaan! Hurry it up or they'll find us!", "Wow, Vaan. You got 'em all yourself? Guess I know who to call when something big comes along!", "Oops! Heh. Totally forgot. You should come, Vaan. He's busy today. Might have some work for you to do, too.", "Look, Vaan, look! This is it! This is why Migelo's courier didn't get here on time!", "That's right! Vaan, you should give it a shot!", 'Oh! Right, right.', "What's wrong, Vaan? Aren't you going to go get that Rogue Tomato? You better hurry up before the ceremony starts. You won't be able to get back into the city!", "Ah, Vaan! I guess I'm not the only one who got locked out of the city! I told Penelo about the mark you were going after, and I guess I got her worrying. So the two of us headed out here to find you. As soon as I stepped out, the guards closed the gates and things got crazy. I haven't been able to find her since.", 'Hey, Vaan. You need inside again?', 'If you say so.', "Hey, Vaan. You here for some more rat hunting? The door's open and ready to go. I still can't get that door on the left open, though. Old Dalan said it led someplace really important ... can't wait to see what's inside!", "Hey, Vaan! I finally worked out how to get the door on the left side open! I hope there's somethin' in there besides rats ... I wanted you to go in first, so I waited for you to come before openin' it. Well, that's one of the reasons I waited ... Thing is, I'm gonna need some special tools to open the door ... Gonna need you to go fetch 'em for me. I know, I know. Not the most exciting thing to do, is it? Heh, heh. I'm just messin' with ya. I've got everything I need ready to go! Hang on while I open it ...", "Hmm, let's see ... Yeah, that should do it ... Huh?", 'Ungh. Urgh. Angh! Hrooph!', "It's open! Now we've got a whole 'nother place to explore! Oh, and I almost forgot. Take these with ya before you go. No tellin' what's down there ... might come in handy.", "Don't know what kind of monsters are down there, but nothin' you can't handle, I bet. Let me know what ya find!", 'Vaan, is it really you? I heard you got took off to Nalbina!', 'You broke out of a dungeon? Whoa!', "Nope, haven't seen her all day. Not like her to up and skip out on work like that. Migelo's not here either. He went running off somewhere a little while ago.", "I got my hands full watching the shop ... and Old Dalan had something for me to do, but I can't get away.", 'Really?', "Thanks for going to see Old Dalan for me. I'm so busy here, I'd never have had time to make it down to Lowtown. I sure hope Migelo shows up soon ...", "Migelo's finally back, but Penelo still hasn't shown up. I hope everything's okay.", "Hey, Vaan. Haven't seen you around much lately. Workin' on somethin' big? Can't wait to hear more about it! You don't have to worry about me and the others. I'll watch after everybody."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["You're on your way to the mines?", "Then please, allow me to accompany you. I've an errand to attend to there.", 'What errand? I might ask the same of you.', 'Excellent.', 'For us both.', "Oh, I – I'm Lamont.", 'Actually, no. With but few exceptions, the Imperial army is not permitted in Bhujerba. Well, shall we proceed?', "Halim Ondore IV, the Marquis of Bhujerba. The Marquis served as the mediator at the negotiations of Dalmasca's surrender. It would appear that he is somewhat less neutral now.", 'They say many things.', 'This is what I came here to see.', "It's nethicite. Manufacted nethicite.", 'Unlike regular magicite, nethicite absorbs magickal energy. This is the fruit of research into the manufacture of nethicite. All at the hands of the Draklor Laboratory.', "So this is where they're getting the magicite.", "Thank you. I'll repay you shortly.", "If it is a crime to wander on one's own ... then I, too, am guilty. Marquis. I trust that your estate can accommodate another guest?", 'Judge Ghis, I shall heed your counsel. I will not travel unaccompanied any longer.', 'Thank you, Penelo.', "You will join him soon. And until then I shall see that you're kept from harm.", 'I am troubled. The Rabanastre Imperial Guard appear to have overstepped their bounds. I intend to speak on this with the Consul.', 'Vayne Solidor, the Consul, is my brother.', 'The first duty of the Consul is to maintain order in Dalmasca. My brother – my brother is not one given to failure. Perhaps things arent going as well as they might be... but give him a little time and he will put things to rights. Be not troubled. My brother is a remarkable man.', 'Why?', 'So, you fear the Empire?', 'Listen to me. The men of my family, we are taught to place the needs of others before our own. I will see that you are kept from harm. It is my duty to House Solidor.', 'Because I give you my word. My brother would do no less.', "Ghis knows you've escaped. You must hurry.", 'You are Captain Azelas. You will follow me. We must reach the airships before they do.', "Lady Ashe. By all rights, you ought not even to exist. That you and Captain Ronsenburg were made to appear dead ... is like a hidden thread laid bare. Your actions hereafter will pull at that thread ... and we will see what it unravels. This is our chance. We must see this through, and get to the bottom of it. I believe 'tis for the good of Dalmasca, and the good of the Empire.", 'I must apologize.', 'Penelo, for you. May it bring you good fortune.', 'Let us go.', 'I say we ought leave tomorrow. I was going to wait for my escort, but meeting you presents a great opportunity. This terrible war can be stopped, but I will need your help to do so.', 'You know the Marquis Ondore leads a group of insurgents - your pardon, he leads a large resistance force against the Empire. Lady Ashe, neither of our countries can afford this now. The Rozarrian Empire would stir. They would aid the Resistance and use this aid as a pretext to declare war on Archadia ... and Archadia would have no choice but to answer. Lady Ashe, let us go to Bur-Omisace. With the blessing of his His Grace the Gran Kiltias Anastasis ... you may rightly wear your crown, and declare the restoration of the Kingdom of Dalmasca. As queen, you can call for peace between the Empire and Dalmasca ... and stop Marquis Ondore.', 'Dalmasca would be the battlefield! What if nethicite were used on Rabanastre? You know my brother would do this!', "I had hoped you'd say yes. I am glad.", "I had other reason to invite you. There is someone I'd like you to meet waiting on Bur-Omisace.", 'An enemy, and an ally also. You will just have to wait and see for yourself.', "The Henne Magicite Mines - maybe that's what she meant. They lie in Bancour, south of the Ozmone Plain. The entire region is a colony of the Archadian Empire. There would be soldiers.", 'Surprisingly rude.', 'Researchers from the Draklor Laboratory. What were they doing here?', 'Look at the magicite. These mines much resemble the ones at Lhusu. Of course. Draklor must be searching for new sources of ore. Should the Resistance move, the magicite in Bhujerba will be forever beyond their grasp.', 'Manufacted nethicite.', 'Then that means - Penelo, the stone I gave you, do you still carry it with you?', 'This is more dangerous than I had imagined. I should never have given it to you. Forgive me. I did not know.', 'And so I sue for peace to stop short war and ease their suffering. My father will choose peace.', 'This is the man I wanted you to meet. Believe it or not, he is a member of the noble House Margrace, rulers of the Rozarrian Empire.', 'Father.', "Restore Dalmasca's sovereignty, and make our amends with Lady Ashe. It is the only way to avert war!", 'I fear you misread her intent. She would sooner shun war than embrace it.', 'And you presume beyond your ken!', 'It will not come to that, I am sure. I have faith in her — faith in you both. On you, Gabranth, shall I wager all our fortunes.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['The men are off on their business, while we women mind the village. Even the children do their part. They make their mistakes, of course, but they learn from them!', "Have you heard? They're saying the Princess is alive! And I'd thought she committed suicide ... I'm not sure what to believe anymore. Those people in the city like nothing more than to gossip, don't they.", "Have you been to the garif village? Our elder and their chieftain go way back, but they haven't seen each other in a cockatrice's age. I make trips to their village to trade sunstones for medicinal herbs, hides ... you name it. And the kids just love that nanna cheese they make.", "Things in Rabanastre finally start to settle down, and now I hear a new storm's brewin'? You take care of yourself, okay? Remember, where there's life, there's hope."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["From Ann? My sister Ann!? Well, uh, I'm Liddy. Pleased to make your acquaintance. Now ... you said you had a letter for me? Hmm. Flowers this year, eh? I suppose that would make Mother happy. But what manner of glamour has you out delivering letters for my sister? Well, no matter. Here, the letter back. You've still some sisters to go. Good luck."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Ah, you must be the lad Rande mentioned the other day. This is ... what, your second airship? I doubt you've the funds to see this through. We're sure to win!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Don't let the desert sun get the best of you. If you're low on supplies, now's the time to stock up.", "If you're westward bound, travel lightly, boy. Not all the races you'll meet in the Sandsea are the civilized variety. And mind the weather. Nice, clear days, the elementals come out in droves. Don't want my customers dying ... bad for business!", "Your errand taking you far abroad, friend? Maybe I have something that you'll be able to use along the way.", "Bright, sunny days are the deadliest out on the sandsea. That's when the elementals come out. You watch yourself 'round those."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["That viera may have left, but not before fallin' for yours truly! (snort) The feelin's mutual, I'm afraid ... She wooed me, and now woe is me!", "That sweet viera longed for me — pined, even! — and I let her slip through my hands ... (snort) I hear she found someone else ... Playin' hard to get, that was my mistake."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Kupo! Not a word from you, kupo. I know why you've come! Oh, and thank you for opening the cell door, by the way. Most gracious of you! After this treatment, I think it's safe to say we won't be visiting any more Imperial warships in the near future. The road calls, kupo!", "Kupo! Where have I seen you before ... ? No matter ... I know why you've come! I've just the thing to help you get to the bottom of all those viera secrets ... Would you like to buy a map, kupo?", 'So long, kupo!', "There are barriers along the paths of Golmore Jungle, kupo. As though the jungle itself chooses who may pass, and who may not. I'm pure as the driven snow ... but I still couldn't get through. Maybe the jungle doesn't like snow...Perhaps I'll ask one of these viera about it.", "Before we came here, we were locked away in a cramped little cell, the sound of machinery clinking and clanking, kupo. But here ... it's so quiet! I can finally hear myself think. Kupo-po-po ...", 'There was a commotion not long ago. Something fell from one of the trees. I get dizzy just thinking about it, kupo. I saw the wood-warders helping what looked to me like a cockatrice. Yes, definitely a cockatrice, kupo.', "A cockatrice just darted past at tremendous speed, kupo. If it's not careful, it's like to have another spill, kupo. Oh, bother."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["A new clan member? Hrgm ... I am Ma'kenroh. A pleasure, I'm sure. Unlike our other members, I cannot participate in hunts. My specialty lies in the collection of information. If you have a question about one of your marks, ask. I will tell you what I know.", "Hello. How does this day find you? Hunting the Rogue Tomato? Hrgm ... Find it in the Dalmasca Estersand. Leave by the east gate, head to the northeast. Now, go. Oh, about your clan rank ... When you've defeated 2 marks and accumulated 700 clan points, you will gain a rank. Now, go."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["You shouldn't sneak up on people like that. Bad for the circulation, you know. Behold the ruin nethicite has wrought on Nabudis. No shadow of its glory remains. It is a spawning pool for creatures that feed on Mist. If you hold life dear, you will turn back ... Me? I am Ma'kleou. I await the coming of a hero. One to destroy the creatures sealed in Nabudis. We foresaw the coming of a hero, and by way of preparation I base my disciples fetch the keys that will break the seals within Nabudis. Roh'kenmou and Roh'kenmu are loyal, but it cannot be said they are quick. You may yet see them returning from this task."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Welcome to Mait's Magicks, newly opened! Remember: we are here to serve you!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Honestly, these people! They come up from the country and they stare, and they stare. But do they buy? Never! Maybe they lack the necessary coin ... Oh, but I do grow weary of this...']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['The Death of Ld. Rasler Heios Nabradia was but one of many Tragedies to befall the Kingdom of Dalmasca.', "The Air of Hope that had surrounded H.R.H. Princess Ashe's Wedding was now quite lost; Dalmasca had been set adrift, at the Mercy of History's restless Tides.", 'At this Time, two Great Empires struggled for Dominion over Ivalice; Archadia in the East, Rozarria, the west.', "The Invasion of the Kingdom of Nabradia was Archadia's first Step in its westward March.", "With Lord Rasler's beloved Homeland consumed by the Hell-Fires of War, it seemed clear that Archadia would soon mete out a like Fate to Dalmasca.", "The Fall of the Fortress at Nalbina tolled the Destruction of the greater part of Dalmasca's Forces.", 'A Counter-Attack was mounted by the Order of the Knights of Dalmasca, ever Brave and Faithful, but against the martial Might of the Archadian Armies, they stood little Chance of Victory.', 'Indeed, their Defeat was to be absolute.', "Soon thereafter, Archadia came forward offering Terms of Peace. Or, as one might rather put it, Terms of Dalmasca's Surrender.", "Lord Raminas, King of Dalmasca – and my Dear Friend – had no Choice but to accept these Terms. It was, thus, only with Reluctance that He set out for Nalbina Fortress – now under Archadian Occupation – to affix His Seal to the Emperor's Treaty of Peace.", 'The King had scarce departed His Royal City of Rabanastre when the Remnants of the Order made their Return. And not a Moment too soon, for a terrible Revelation awaited them.', 'The Treaty would be signed with Steel and Writ in royal Blood.', "Pretenses of Peace left by the Wayside, the Archadian Forces resumed their Advance toward Rabanastre. Dalmasca's Doom had been decided.", '"Sons and Daughters of Dalmasca, I bid you lay down your Arms. Raise Songs of Prayer in their Stead. Prayer for His Majesty King Raminas, ever merciful. A Man devoted wholly to Peace.', '"Prayer, too, for the noble Princess Ashe, who, wrought with Grief at her Kingdom\'s defeat, has taken her own Life.', '"Know also that Capt. Basch fon Ronsenburg, for Incitement of Sedition and the Assassination of H.R.M. King Raminas, has been found Guilty of High Treason and put to his Death.', "Dalmasca's Surrender without Terms was soon to follow.", 'I can assure you it reaches Lord Vayne most discreetly.', 'Be that as it may, I have no intention of being bridled, Your Honor.', 'Why not?', 'Sir Basch fon Ronsenburg. It was not so very long ago that I announced you had been executed.', "So you are the sword he's strung above my head. Vayne has left not a thing to chance. And?", 'This resistance leader – this Amalia. She must be very important.', "You understand I've my position to consider.", "I'm afraid you're too late. Lord Larsa's cortege has already rejoined the Imperial detachment. I am told they will depart for Rabanastre upon the arrival of the fleet this eventide.", "Captain Ronsenburg. Surely the exigencies of position are not lost on you. Why, indeed, you should find the enemy's chains ... an easy burden to bear.", 'Summon the guard!', "They're to be taken to Judge Ghis.", "However, when I made the announcement that you had taken your own life ... I must have seemed a model citizen of the Empire. The announcement, you see, was Vayne's suggestion. At the time, I was reluctant, but I could not perceive his reasons. Now it is clear: he meant to drive a wedge between us.", "I once knew a girl whose only wish ... was to be carried in her uncle's arms. Your Majesty is a woman grown now.", 'Suppose for a moment that you were to defeat Vayne ... What then? You cannot simply rebuild your kingdom with the only proof of your birthright stolen. The Gran-Kiltias on Bur-Omisace cannot recognize you as the rightful heir without it. You may yet be a princess, but without proof of your identity, you are powerless. You will remain with me. We will do nothing till the time is right.', 'Then what does Your Majesty propose we do?', 'This can be arranged, though it will take some time.', 'The Dreadnought Leviathan is sunk. The 8th Fleet of the Archadian Imperial Army, lost.', 'As Word of the Events in the Jagd sounded throughout the Empire, quit I Bhujerba, citing sudden Malady.', 'My true Motive: to bring the various counter-Imperial Forces scattered throughout Ivalice together in unified Resistance.', 'By this Time, Lady Ashe had made her Return to Rabanastre. She had not, however, made known her Presence. Rather, she was content with keeping both her Whereabouts, and those of the Dawn Shard, concealed.', 'Had she chosen to go before her People, my Error in announcing her Suicide would be known, to the great Detriment of my Efforts to assemble a Resistance.', "In such Circumstance as the Lady Ashe then found herself, even were she to proclaim Dalmasca restored, it would serve only to invite the Empire's Wrath.", 'Though Archadia had lost her 8th Fleet, she remained, as ever, a Military Power with which to be reckoned.', 'It is good to know the lady still lives, but what of our bid for the Stone?', "I pray 'tis sharp enough.", 'For the time being, we will continue to train the Resistance army. Enough power on our side ... and even Vayne may see the appeal of the treaty table.', 'All the more reason for me to support your infiltration of the capital. You said it yourself: the nethicite is a powerful weapon. I would have you acquire it for me.', 'If there is no Stone, I would have to look elsewhere for aid.', 'As I must. Failure is not an option.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Have you come to see the dark crystals? Not everyone takes well to the heat of the Giza Plains. We don't have much to offer, but you're welcome to rest here, if you like. These dark crystals absorb the light of the sun, until they shine with a brilliant light. People are always surprised just how bright they are.", "Have you come to see the dark crystals? Not everyone takes well to the heat of the Giza Plains. ... Ah, so it is a sunstone you seek! You've come to the right place. They can only be made here in Giza. They're quite valuable, though, so we can't go handing them out to just anyone who happens to wander through our camp. You see, we make and sell sunstones to earn the money we need to survive. Still, perhaps we can come to some arrangement ... Would you hear my offer?", "The making of sunstones is a chore we give to the children of our camp. They roam the plains, traveling from dark crystal to dark crystal, drawing the light from the crystals into shadestones. One of these children, Jinn, has not yet returned. He left carrying our supply of shadestones. If you'll find Jinn for me and tell him to come back to the camp, you may take one of the sunstones he's made in return. Some of the children said they might have seen him to the south of the camp. You may want to speak with them yourself before leaving. Please, find Jinn and tell him to return at once.", 'Of course. Our troubles need not concern you.', "Seems you haven't given up on finding a sunstone just yet. But as I said, we do not part with the fruits of our labors lightly. If you are serious, then hear my offer.", "The making of sunstones is a chore we give to the children of our camp. They roam the plains, traveling from dark crystal to dark crystal, drawing the light from the crystals into shadestones. One of these children, Jinn, has not yet returned. He left carrying our supply of shadestones. If you'll find Jinn for me and tell him to come back to the camp, you may take one of the sunstones he's made in return. Some of the children said they might have seen him to the south of the camp. You may want to speak with them yourself before leaving. Please, find Jinn and tell him to return at once.", 'Of course. Our troubles need not concern you.', 'Please, find Jinn and tell him to return to camp. One of the children, Camina, saw him. You should speak with her before leaving. And be careful – werewolves stalk the southern plains. If you see one approaching, run. It would make short work of you.', "Jinn made it back home safe and sound. He is a good boy, but how his mind wanders! He never thinks of the worry it causes me! I'm sorry if he was any trouble. Please, take these with my thanks.", 'Jinn gave you a sunstone, yes? I hope it may be of some help to you.', "Has the sunstone been of use? Jinn makes very high quality stones – they always fetch a good price. You're fortunate you came when you did: the crystals do not always shine. Many have come seeking sunstones only to leave empty-handed.", 'There is much work to be had on the plains. When light returns to the crystals, you might try your hand at making sunstones.', "Don't often get visitors in this heat. What is it?", "Did you notice the dark crystals? They again shine with light. No small thanks to the fine weather we've enjoyed these past days. Are you interested in making some sunstones?", "There, now you've the shadestone you need. Fill it with the light of the dark crystals and return when you've made a sunstone. I pay well for stones of high grade!", "You've made one before, yes? So the process should be familiar to you. You'll take a shadestone to the shining crystals of the plains and fill it with their light. That's your sunstone. The energy gauge will show you how much light the shadestone has absorbed. When the gauge is full, your work is done. Once you begin, you should stick to the task. If you leave the plains before you finish, any energy the shadestone has stored will be lost. The dark crystals of the plains wax and wane with light — a measure of the sun's own fickle nature. Are you clear on how to make a sunstone?", 'Well, you seem eager. Ready to make a sunstone?', 'I pay well for stones of high grade. I wish you luck!', "You're always welcome, if you change your mind. We pay well for stones of a high grade, should you need a few extra gil.", "You're always welcome, if you change your mind. We pay well for stones of a high grade, should you need a few extra gil.", 'Jinn and my son have been getting along just fine. A little friendly competition can be a healthy thing, really.', "Don't often get visitors in this heat. What is it?", 'Take the shadestone I gave you to the shining crystals on the plains. When the energy gauge is full, the sunstone is ready. If you have trouble finding the crystals, stop and take a look around. Remember, I pay well for stones of quality.', 'Jinn and my son have been getting along just fine. A little friendly competition can be a healthy thing, really.', "Don't often get visitors in this heat. What is it?", "I see you've made a sunstone. Interested in parting with it?", "This is a sunstone of highest grade! You don't see many of these.", 'Should you change your mind, do let me know.', 'Jinn and my son have been getting along just fine. A little friendly competition can be a healthy thing, really.', "Don't often get visitors in this heat. What is it?", "Did you notice the dark crystals? They again shine with light. No small thanks to the fine weather we've enjoyed these past days. Are you interested in making some sunstones?", "You're always welcome, if you change your mind. We pay well for stones of a high grade, should you need a few extra gil.", "The garif live to the south, in northern Kerwon. They are an ancient race, who live by the ways of their ancestors. They wear masks from the day they're born until the day they die."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Welcome to the Cloudborne, traveler, where all Bhujerba comes to forget the worries of the day. I'm the taverner, Melisa, at your service. Sit down, rest your feet, boy ... Kah? A resistance? Crazy! All right, who gave this boy here a sip of the madhu?", 'Haa. Hello there, boy. Quite the performance back there. Do not think for a moment that all of us accept you. And watch what you say outside.', "Haa. Hello again. Havharo? He's not here. Why, I'd say he's off in the sky with the Marquis by now ...", "Haa ... We have lost much money this month. Men cannot drink if they are away at war. And should they win, we will shower them with fine Bhujerban Madhu ... and we'll lose even more money. As much as it pains me, that's money I hope to lose."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Ah, Vaan, I was waiting.', "Ah! Had me some packages supposed to be arriving by courier in the morning. Perhaps he ran into some trouble out in the desert. Now I've no foodstuffs to prepare for the banquet tonight!", "No problem? The desert teems with trouble. I'd be sending you to an early grave, m'boy. No, I've arranged for some replacement goods from Tomaj over at the Sandsea.", "Actually, I asked Kytes to do that. Wouldn't you know he's gone missing on me, too. Bah. I can't leave my shop and I've Penelo on another chore at the moment, you see. I want you to run over to the Sandsea and fetch Kytes back! What do you say?", "It's easy work, and you'll thank me for it someday.", "Well? Have you found Kytes yet? Bah! I don't know what I'm going to do with the lot of you ... Oh, I'm grateful for your help. You work hard – when you want to. But lately you don't seem to want to, do you? What was it that set me off complaining? Ah, yes. Kytes. Go find Kytes! He should be at the Sandsea. Hurry now! Time's a-wasting!", "Oh, Kytes is back – he's been on tenterhooks ever since he walked in the door. Well, so long as he's not up to any mischief ...", "Ho, ho! A fine, fine chocobo you have there. Yes! Tchita Downs stock, if I'm not mistaken. Change the soil, change the chocobo, am I right?", "Yes, yes. Different soil means different bouquet, too. Take a Dalmascan Barose wine, eh? It may lack the flavor and depth of some of your Archadian wines ... but it has a certain strength of character. It's not bad, really, once you get used to it. Care for some, sirs? There's more than enough for all to cool their throats, of course.", "Don't give me a scare like that. You're lucky that ended where it did.", "Ah, the ceremony'll be starting soon. I'd best be hurrying.", 'I am Migelo, Your Highness.', 'I meant no disrespect.', 'Eh, I could not. That would not be right.', 'Misunderstanding? What I am understanding is they took Penelo because of you!', "Oh, Vaan! They've taken Penelo! And there was a note – a note for this Balthier! Come to the Bhujerba mines, it said.", "If anything were to happen to that sweet child – why, I've her parents' memory to consider! You're going to go to her aid, and that's that!
