It's what you sky pirates do, isn't it?", "What a terrible thing to have happened! You've got to see that Penelo gets back home safely, Vaan!", "Ah, Penelo! You're all right! Those sky pirates got you tangled up in some nasty business. What!? Don't tell me you're off running about with those sky pirates, too! Vaan I can understand, but you, Penelo? ... Ah, I see. I suppose I have been a bit over protective of you. It's time you made your own decisions, your own mistakes. Do as you feel you must. Whatever trouble you might get yourselves into will only make you stronger, I'm sure. Yes, yes. When you want to come back, you've only – No, no, you go about your adventures until you decide for yourselves it's time. And until then, don't worry yourselves about the shop or any of your friends. Just leave all that to Migelo, you hear? Now that that's decided, we should get down to business. If you'll be traveling, you'll be needing sundries, yes? Well, sundries we have!", "Keeping busy, are you, Vaan? You needn't worry yourself about the store. I won't be closing just because you aren't around. No, there are plenty of other hard-working youths to pick up your slack. Off with you now! We'll be here when you get back.", "Making trouble with the Imperials, sneaking into the sewers ... never know which way the wind blows with you, m'boy! Now you're traveling the world! I won't try to stop you, though. Just you be sure to look after Penelo while you're at it, eh?", "Old Dalan came by the shop for a friendly chat the other day. Why, I can't remember the last time he'd been in for a visit. He had a few things he wanted to get off his chest: Marquis Ondore's plotting and what not. You know I would never try to stop you from doing something you'd set your mind to, but do be careful, m'boy. You do what you think is right. Then, when it suits you, you come back home to Rabanastre. Rabanastre is your home."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["My husband died protecting me and my son during the war. I'm only glad that I survived. Not for myself, but for our child. No one should have to grow up alone in a world like this.", 'The poor little guy. What am I going to do?']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['The stench of humes. The stench of power.', 'Stay away! Power-needy hume!', 'Is it you?', 'When the hume soldiers came to the Wood, the village took small heed of them. So long as the Wood Herself is safe, the viera give little care to goings on beyond. But in me an uneasiness stirred. I had to discover why they had come.', 'That cannot be all! I saw it when I left the village! Ivalice is changing! How can the viera stand and do nothing at all?', 'But that is wrong! How can we just hide here in the trees when all the world outside is on the move! I, too, wish to live freely - to leave this Wood!', 'But Fran - my sister!', 'An indescribable sensation overtook me within the mine. It reached out, closed about my heart ... then all was darkness. This loathsome shadow ... ageless and ancient beyond any viera or hume ... what was it?', 'Whence has this cockatrice come? These beasts, too, know loneliness ...', 'The will to quell my thoughts of the world outside the Wood ... the courage to live beyond Her ... Neither do I possess. Will I never share in the strength of my sisters?', 'Whence has this cockatrice come? These beasts, too, know loneliness ...', 'Whence has this cockatrice come? These beasts, too, know loneliness ... Is that a dewdrop pebble you have there? They are said to bring fortune to you on the day you find them. I remember gathering pebbles with my sister ...', 'Dewdrop pebbles are no common stones. They sometimes rain down with the afternoon showers or during thick morning fogs. They cannot be carried beyond the village, for they vanish. The pebbles can exist only here ... unlike the viera.', 'The dewdrop pebbles cannot survive outside the village. Should you leave, they will be lost.', 'It seems to show interest in dewdrop pebbles. Should you find some, will you bring them here?', 'This beast seems to show an interest in the pebbles. I thought I might show it more should I find any. Have you found any more?', 'The dewdrop pebbles fall in great number. It is not usual to find so many. And all of a common size. As though someone were ... gathering them.', 'The dewdrop pebbles cannot survive outside the village. Should you leave, they will be lost.', "I believe it's memory is lost. Looking on dewdrop pebbles seems to be of some help, though. It is close now to remembering, I can feel it.", 'I believe its memory is lost. Looking on the pebbles seems to be of some help, though. It is close now to remembering, I can feel it. You have found more of the pebbles?', 'Thank you. I think this should be enough to help our visitor.', 'The dewdrop pebbles cannot survive outside the village. Should you leave, they will be lost.', 'You have gathered many dewdrop pebbles. Enough even to make a pendant, I would think.', 'Have you remembered?', 'The rest is ... memorable. You are lucky to have been caught on the tree. Lucky, too, that its limbs held fast. A fall from this height would have been fatal. When the Wood-warders reached you, you were quite unconscious.', 'A kindred spirit ...', 'So long was she here, I had begun to grow fond of her. I am sorry to see her go, but it is good she will be home again.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["What are you lookin' at? This ain't no place for children! Him? He's an exception. His parents were both hunters. And they were friends of mine to boot. That is, until they set out on a hunt for this one most notorious mark ... But I'll avenge them, be sure of it! I've been keeping an ear to the ground, listening for any sign of that mark ever since. That's what this place is all about. A deadly serious business, this, not to be taken lightly, you hear?", "You've got much and more to learn, and you can start with this: stay out of my way! I'd as soon kill you as look at you, so don't be trying my patience."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Kupo-po? Yours is a new face! Are you a hunter? Welcome to our clan hall! I'm Montblanc, founder of Clan Centurio. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance, kupo! Our clan has a very strict entrance examination. We should begin yours at once ... And, you pass. Moogles are quick to make up their minds, kupo.", "Here in the clan hall you'll hear about especially dangerous marks you won't find posted on any board, the moment they rear their ugly heads! Well, I'll get on with filing the necessary clan membership certificates. I'll be finished in no time flat, kupo! Kupo! I nearly forgot! Now that you're a member, you can make purchases from our clan shop in the Muthru Bazaar. Be sure to stop by, kupo! Happy hunting!", "How fares the hunt, kupo? All your membership papers are in order, kupo. Allow me to give you this to commemorate your joining the guild! I'll have a little something for you each time you attain a new clan rank, kupo.", 'Keep up the splendid work, kupo!', "Kupo-po? I'm sorry, but I don't have any hunts to tell you about at the moment, kupo.", "How fares the hunt, kupo? Kupo-po? I'm sorry, but I don't have any hunts to tell you about at the moment, kupo."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Blimey! Wot's yer game then, eh? I ain't goin' nowhere, mate! I'm 'appy 'ere, thanks fer askin'.", "If I'd've known they'd be strappin' such 'eavy loads on me back, I'd've made out like I was a bloomin' cockatrice! Cor ... it ain't 'alf 'ard bein' a chocobo."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["A travelin' mummer taught me this one. Used to live 'ere in the city, so 'e said."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["You've come from the city? Our village may be small, but you are welcome here. Our village moves with the seasons. When the Rains come, Giza fills with water, so we cannot stay.", 'I sent my little brother to Rabanastre to buy a few things we needed, but he spent all the change before coming back. Can you believe it?', "I thought my little brother had been working hard lately, but now i find out he's just been planning to sneak off to Kerwon. Can you believe it?", "Sometimes I fly off the handle when I'm talking to my little brother. But he's probably old enough not to be treated like a kid anymore. Then again, the way he's been acting, I can't rely on him for much of anything. Oh, what am I going to do with him?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Mjrn? Why do you ask after her? I am not she. What is it you seek?', 'To show interest in the world outside is forbidden by our laws, but a mind once open to the unknown will not be denied. Is this not what has brought you to us?', 'In truth I should not speak with you. But it is all right. The others do not concern themselves with my doings. Here I was born, and here I live. I do not think, though, that past and present need dictate the future.', 'The Green Word, the laws of our village, a future filled with ruin ... if we dwell on such weighty matters, we are like to collapse under the burden. There is no end that is not also a beginning. The sun will rise and fall as it always has ... this is enough for me.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Good day, bhadra. No ... no, it is not a good day, for my son has run away from home! Should you see him, please, tell him to come back. My son's name is Yrlon, you see. I'm afraid I was too harsh on him for breaking my prized bottle of Bhujerban Madhu ...", 'Ronsen ... burg? Where have I heard this name before? Ah, yes! I remember ... No, no. I do not.', 'Basch? Who is that? Is he a nobleman? Is he a great man? ... Is he a bad man?']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Don't you worry about the Strahl, kupo. I'll keep an eye on her. No, wait! Both eyes!", "Terrible news, kupo! When the Imperial fleet exploded over the Westersand, the Strahl was damaged! I'm gathering the parts I need to make repairs as quickly as I can, but it may take some time, kupo.", "I've almost finished repairing the Strahl, kupo! I'm working morning, noon, and night ... shouldn't be much longer!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["I saw a real familiar lookin' man walk past just a while ago, and it's killin' me I can't remember who he is. Had an unkempt beard ... you know him?", "Watchin' Filo and her friends play at pirates reminds me of when I was a kid. We'd run around pretendin' we were real sky pirates – had a secret hideout and everything. Things were so much simpler back then.", "Cotze sent ya? Wow, I'd almost forgotten about playing out in those storms ... but not completely. What ya need is a windvane to get through. Cotze and me had it split up into two pieces ... one each, get it? That way we could only go to our secret hideout together. But I buried my half. Head west in the Westersand and you'll come to a dead end with these giant dynast-cactuses. It's under one of them. Think you can find it? And remember, you're not lookin' for the windvane itself, just one of the two parts we split it into.", "My half of the windvane is west in the Westersand, at a dead end under a dynast-cactus. They're big, round cactuses with yellow flowers on top. And remember, you're not lookin' for the windvane itself, just one of the two parts we split it into. Hope you find it!", "Well, we saw it with our own eyes. A strange sort of ... egg. And it wasn't long before it hatched.", "That's because it is. Let me have a look ...", "There. This should let you make your way through the storm. Now you just need to decide whether that's really what you want to be doin'."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["I'm just a traveling moogle, trying to scrape by. I should be here while the Dry holds, kupo. But the monsters during the Rains are too scary! The Dry should last a while longer, but take care during the Rains, kupo. Those big lightning balls don't mess around. Would you like to buy a map, kupo?", 'So long, kupo!', "Be careful during the Rains, kupo, it draws out the lightning balls. I think they're elementals, but I'd avoid them, whatever they are.", 'An elemental was chasing me, kupo! The rain was pouring down, and I could feel my fur crickle-crackle when it came near. Horrifying! Would you like to buy a map, kupo?...', "Have you ever seen an elemental, kupo? They come out during the Rains, all a-crackle. Whatever you do, don't touch one! Kupo!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Ahh, if it isn't Vaan Ratsbane. Come for a tip on how to skewer something bigger and in armor? By the east gate?", 'Wise I may not be, but well-informed I am.', 'Do tell!', "Not one to mince words, are you, boy. The Empire protects what's hers. That means the palace and all the treasures inside.", 'So our champion of the sewers aspires to noble action. Admirable. Perhaps I can help you. Ah, now that I think on it, there was a rumor, yes. A secret passageway into the palace vaults, a door, and a magicked stone to open the way.', "Eh? Oh, I've had it for years. If I can remember where I've tucked it away ...", 'Not much of a listener, are you ... The Crescent Stone has lost its magicks. Without the power of a sunstone, it will be of little use.', "You seek Giza Plains. Speak with the nomads there. You will find your sunstone. Leave by Southgate and continue south. Their village is not far. There are like to be beasts on the plains, so be careful, m'boy.", 'I need that sunstone, Vaan. You should start by talking to the nomads on the Giza Plains. If you leave by Southgate, their village is not far.', "Oh ho! So you've got a sunstone, have you? Hand it over, m'boy, and I'll use it to give the Crescent Stone back its magicks like I promised.", 'Now you\'ll be wanting to know how to sneak into the palace, eh? First you go to Storehouse 5. You know the one. Two doors she has. Now the right takes Vaan Ratsbane to his territorial hunting grounds in the sewerbottom ... But that\'s not the way you\'ll go. No, you\'ll take the left door, down into the Garamsythe Waterway. The waterway leads to a stair, the stair to the palace cellars. That\'s your way in. But don\'t go counting your gil just yet, m\'boy. Getting into the palace was the easy part. The way into the treasury is carefully hidden. That\'s where this Crescent Stone comes in. The magicks it bears can open the hidden door to the treasury, you see. Listen, Vaan, for the words I shall speak are most important, and not to be forgotten. Do you understand? "The signet yearns for sunstone\'s strength, to light the clouded way." Once in the palace, you\'ll find the signet tile. Very important. Give to it the sun\'s power, and it will light your path. Very well. Oh, a warning: be aware that if you\'re caught ... you\'ll spend the rest of your short life rotting in the Nalbina dungeons. So, look sharp, m\'boy. And don\'t go running off before you\'re ready. Plans freshly hatched have a habit of tumbling from the nest ... straight into the hunter\'s stewpot.', 'Need to hear the way in once more, do you?', 'First you go to Storehouse 5 – you know the one. Two doors she has. The right takes you to your territorial hunting grounds in the sewerbottom, but you\'ll take the left door, down into the Garamsythe Waterway. The waterway leads to a stair, the stair to the palace cellars. That\'s your way in. But don\'t go counting your gil just yet, m\'boy. Getting into the palace was the easy part. The way into the treasury is carefully hidden. That\'s where the Crescent Stone comes in. The magicks it bears can open the hidden door to the treasury, you see. Listen, Vaan, for the words I shall speak are most important: "The signet yearns for sunstone\'s strength, to light the clouded way." Once in the palace, you\'ll find the signet tile. Give to it the sun\'s power, and it will light your path.', "Be careful, m'boy. Go getting yourself in trouble, and the ones who care about you also suffer. Think of that before you do anything rash.", 'Well, well. Look who we have here! Heard you were sent off to Nalbina?', "My, my, my. Quite a treasure you've got there.", "So, there is more to this gutter-churl than first meets the eye. Vaan, I've an errand: a simple favor to beg of you. I was going to ask that Kytes to go, but I should think that you ought to do. No – no I think you're just the one. There's a fellow by the name of Azelas, and I need you to bring this sword to him.", "Speak my name when you arrive. That should be enough to get you in to see him. I've made a note on your map showing you where he can be found. Mind you, you are to deliver the sword to him personally.", 'You can just leave that to me.', 'And so it is done. But will it be enough to remind him of what the Order once meant?', "Well, m'boy? The mark on your map not big enough for you? I should think you know the North Sprawl well enough, no?", "I was just about to look into this Penelo business, and – what? Kidnapped!? So you're off to the Lhusu Mines with this sky pirate then, are you? Why, that's in Bhujerba ... Can he even be trusted? No time to worry over that now ... Listen to me, Vaan. You must hurry to Penelo. And be careful. Careful for both your sakes.", "The garif? Let me think ... Yes, I have seen the garif here in Rabanastre, though it was long ago. Hm. I can't remember when the last time was. They live in the southwest of Ozmone Plain, to the south of Giza.", "Mt. Bur-Omisace? Let me think ... What could you possibly need to go there for, m'boy? Well, it's none of my business, I suppose. The Gran Kiltias Anastasis leads the Light from Bur-Omisace. He is a wise man, said to find hidden truths in his dreams.", 'I can tell there is something you want to ask me, but you hesitate. Not sure whether you can tell Old Dalan your troubles, eh? Listen to me, Vaan. If you trust in yourself, and do what you feel is right, you will not fail. There is no better advice I can give than that.', "So, you go now to Archades, do you? And afoot, no less ... Let us see ... that would take you first north, through the Mosphoran Highwaste. This will bring you to the Salikawood. There you must pass through a great gate on its eastern border before continuing further east still. I won't even ask what takes you to Archades ... I ask only that you do nothing I would not do, heh heh.", 'Giruvegan, you say!? Sadly, even I have little to share with you about such a place. I know it lies deep within a forest ... and nothing more. Vaan, tell me ... what exactly are you up to?']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["You think you might ... . not stare at me? I'm in the midst of a very important conversation."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["We've many fine armors to choose from. If you see a piece you like, there's no time to buy like the present!", "Interest you in a piece of armor? If there's aught to your liking, I'll have it brought 'round. But don't dawdle, I've plans for the evening.", "We've a fine assortment of armors for the choosing. There's sure to be something to tickle your fancy! Why, that's a most unusual stone you've got there! Don't suppose you'd be interested in sellin'? N-No, what am I saying! If I go off buying odd knickknacks again, me mum will have a fit! Now, where was I? Ah, yes! Armors! Armors for the choosing!", "War is in the air. Best buy what you need while there's aught left to buy!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['What do you mean, "yours"? You\'ve been stealing again. What happens if they catch you?', "We need you to be there for us, Vaan. You're no good to anyone if you're locked away in a dungeon!", "I thought this money was the people of Dalmasca's property. The Imperials stole it from us, so it's only fair that we take it back. It's our duty as Dalmascans. Well, wasn't that what you said?", "This is for that bread you took the other day. Just because I help Migelo out every now and then ... it doesn't mean that you get to eat for free, too, you know.", "Well, be careful. You'll never fly anything if you're rotting in a dungeon!", 'Oh, Migelo had some errands that need doing. He wanted you to drop by his place. It might be a good idea to lend a hand.', "Migelo seemed like he was in a hurry. He's probably still at the shop ... better not keep him waiting too long.", 'Did you finish the chores Migelo set you to already?', "Right. Now's our chance to go through.", 'Vaan! Wait!', 'What is it? Vaan?', "Vaan, you just do not get it, do you. He's not doing it because he wants to. You know what would happen if he didn't?", 'So, what would you do different?', 'Vaan?', "Vaan! You haven't heard a single word I've said, have you.", "This place has changed so much. It's like it's not even Rabanastre anymore. Like the Empire is swallowing it whole.", "Are you crazy? It's in the palace, and we don't have an invitation, if you hadn't noticed.", "As if I'd know. Why not ask Migelo to get you in? Or go see Old Dalan in Lowtown. Why the sudden interest, Vaan?", "Oh please! You know as well as I do the first thing you'd buy is an airship! All hail Vaan, sky pirate of Dalmasca! It's got a nice ring to it! Stay outta trouble!", "Migelo's out getting ready for the fete. Do you think he'll really call the new consul by his first name? I think he'd sooner die.", "I could ask you the same! Though the answer's pretty clear: no good.", "Hmm. Is that right? So, then, you wouldn't mind if I, say, tagged along, would you? Oh, don't worry. Migelo's busy with preparations for the fete up at the palace. Why, I'm free for the whole day. Well? Let's get going!", 'Hey, Vaan. Let me give you these before we go. There are all sorts of monsters out there, so you can never be too careful!', "So far you've been traveling by yourself, but now that I'm here we can travel as a party. You can give commands to allies in your party just like you've been doing for yourself up to now. I'll make my own decisions about what to do, too, but you can also give me specific commands and I'll take care of those first. Got it?", "Oh, one more thing! If you don't want me to fight on my own, you can always turn my gambits off. With my gambits turned off, I won't do anything until you give the word. You should really think about using gambits for yourself, you know. They can make managing a battle a lot easier.", 'Well, you ready to go?', "Vaan, wasn't Jinn supposed to be somewhere to the south of the village? If we work our way around, we should find him!", 'So this is what the kids on Giza Plains do to make their way ... Maybe one of them will take you on as an apprentice.', "Let's take it back to Jinn and see what he says. I hope we did it right.", 'Hey Vaan?', "It's been a long time since we did anything together. Too long. I had a really good time. Well, I should probably get back to the store. Actually, I was kind of supposed to be watching the place for Migelo. And, Vaan – Try to stay out of trouble. For me? I don't know what I'd do if you weren't here. If something happened to you.", "That's what I wanted to hear. See ya later.", 'Wait!', "He didn't know what he was doing! You have to let him go! You have to!", 'I told you!', 'Leave him alone!', 'I keep trying to tell you, I barely even know who Balthier is!', "That's what I'd like to know! I just met him that one time and that's it!", 'Where are you?', 'O-Of course.', "So Vaan really is all right. I didn't think I'd ever get to see him again.", 'Thank you.', 'What?', 'He frightens me.', "I'm sorry. He is your brother. It's just -- you don't understand how much we lost to the war. My friends, my parents.", 'But how? How can I trust you?', 'Vaan!', 'Thanks.', 'What was that?', "Can't we go faster?", 'Balthier, your handkerchief. I thought you might want it back.', "Then I'm coming too.", "Don't leave me here!", 'Happy you get to teach me something for a change?', "So, where exactly is Raithwall's tomb?", "You don't have to worry about me. I'm tougher than I look.", 'Incredible ...', 'Fog? Underground?', 'You can see the Mist? With your eyes?', 'So, is the Mist dangerous?', "I'll keep that in mind.", "Can't count on Vaan to keep track of these things. That's for sure.", 'The nethicite?', "What's wrong with her?", "What's that?", 'Larsa?', "I bet they'll be glad to see you after so long.", 'Try to grow up, please.', "Sure, it's right here.", "I'd always thought of it as a sort of good luck charm. And even if it is dangerous, on Leviathan it kept us safe.", 'Wait - what about Larsa?', "But what about once we're inside? Won't the city watch find us?", "You're gaping like a fish out of water.", "You've changed, Vaan. You were always marching to your own beat ... almost like you were impatient, even. In a good way.", "You always were a soft touch, Vaan. You know what's amazing? I thought I'd go my whole life without meeting people like the Princess, or Lord Larsa. And here we are in the capital!", "That wasn't a complaint, was it, Basch?", "Hey, don't change the subject!", "What? That's crazy!", 'Right.', 'What is it, Fran?', "So we're not going inside?", 'What is it?', "I can't shake the feeling we're somewhere we're not meant to be.", 'Exciting?', "I've never seen this much Mist. Are you all right?", "Um ... Does anyone know what happened to Dr. Cid? Wasn't he saying he'd be here?", "But wait — if we got a hold of the nethicite, wouldn't that be bad for the Empire?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Oh dear, kupo ... I have ... (sigh) I cannot tell you. You are a stranger.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["When will I ever get to sleep ... It's the same voice ... Always the same ..."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['You shame us by seeking aid outside the tribe! Urutan-Yensa are lords and masters of the great sea! We seek the aid of none!', 'Your words are the howling of the sand to my ears! I condemn you to dust!', 'Those who sully our name will be punished, be they foeman or kin. They must pay the honor-price. There can be no forgiveness! I would destroy you, too ... but I am merciful. Better you live to tell the world that the Urutan are not to be taken lightly. Now, leave!']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['What errand have you with Mjrn? What errand could you have? You should leave before aught ill comes to pass. For your sake, and our own.', 'You have spoken with Jote. The wood-warders brook no trespass within the village. Leave now, and do not look back.', 'We have known of the humes in the magicite mines. They fear us, and have not disturbed the Wood. We keep watch on them, but we do not interfere. Mjrn knew of this, but this was not enough for her. She left the Wood.', 'There are those who blame Jote for the deeds of her sisters. As elder, she must always defend the village. Until now, diligently she has. But she is not alone. We wood-warders stand at her side. Together we defend the Wood.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Impossible!', 'Secure Nalbina with all haste.', 'Galtea stand watch over your life.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["What is it you want? We're in the middle of a personal, and rather important, conversation. Get lost, why don't you.", "Enough is enough? Hah! Will you listen to her? Ann, I tell you, you defy all reason. What sane woman would decline a proposal of marriage from a man of my birth, stature, incomes, and obvious charms? Can your mother really mean all that to you? I've told you a thousand times, you must forget these people back in Old Archades!", "You seem to share your sisters' dislike of the noble House Lirschell. But what grudge could you possibly harbor against us?", 'Yes, yes ... your passengers ... An idea comes to mind. Might I interest you in a game of sorts?', "Last year for your mother's name day you and your sisters each sent her a gift you'd found along the routes you work, yes?", 'This year, I propose that you each gather a flower for your mother, and that this boy here informs each of your sisters of the arrangement. If he can deliver the message to every one of them, my brothers and I will abandon all hope of marriage to you and your sisters.', "She has a point. Six ships, six sisters ... quite a lot of work for someone we don't know. Better to forget the whole business. And me? I'll begin making the necessary preparations for our wedding.", "I can't remember the last time I had more fun. Already visions of you and your sisters joining the noble House Lirschell fill my mind."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['My father?', 'And I will go at his side.', 'That I be considered worthy.', 'No! The paling still stands!', "The paling's fallen!", 'For my father. For my father!', 'A marriage of convenience. A symbol of the alliance between Nabradia and Dalmasca. This is how they see our match.', 'These roles we play... I must admit I find it wearying.', 'I would have no other.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["I've got me a nose for ill intent. I'll take the measure of 'im.", 'Arr ... aye ... not bad at all! He measures up quite nicely. This one means no harm to Lord Reddas.', 'Aye, he speaks of the hidden trial of the Feywood, which must be passed to open the gate to the holy land of Giruvegan.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Ah. My apologies. You bear not the stench of Cid's lackies.", "Yes, a valuable man, one I'd sooner not lose. Yet he knows too much.", 'Cid. You know deifacted nethicite brought down the Leviathan! How can you persist in this folly?', "Lend him not your ears, m'lady. He means to use you.", 'Mayhaps you think me remiss! The Lady Ashe of Dalmasca?', 'The sky pirate Reddas, at your employ.', 'A city of men without countries. Pirates of the sea and of the sky. Few are they who would fain lay down their lives for a friend, let alone a king.', 'The time approaches when he must make his position vis-a-vis the Empire clear. When he helped you off the Leviathan, he spited the Judges full sore. He cannot sit in idleness and expect to avoid a reckoning. The Marquis shares my distaste for war ... yet if it comes to it, he will show no quarter.', 'Yet Vayne holds the nethicite. What makes you think he would treat when he holds such lower? Power enough to sink the Leviathan.', 'I have not said I would give you the Midlight Shard.', 'Then you would ally with Rozarria.', 'Then you seek the Jagd Difohr. Deep within the jungle of Golmore, there is a corner of the Feywood where a Mist-storm surges and seethes.', "Cid's words rang hollow to me. I will follow another course.", 'I could well say the same to you, pirate.', "Ah, Vaan! I've had some of my men check on this Feywood. Best ask what they've found.", 'Fly first, ask questions later. Your apprentice is more pirate than you.', 'Princess Ashe! I would hear your heart. If Doctor Cid has spoken the truth, you may well be rewarded with more nethicite in Giruvegan. Tell me: do you still desire the Stone?', 'Do not forget Nabudis. That is my only counsel for you.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Reks, sir. My name is Reks.', "I'm fine, sir.", 'Seventeen, sir.', "My brother is all I have left, sir. He's two years younger than I, living in Rabanastre.", 'No, sir. I want to fight. For my homeland, and for my parents.', 'Captain?', 'What if Captain Azelas has fallen?', 'Is His Majesty unharmed?', "Sir! We have little time! You must go to the king! I'll handle these!", 'Your Majesty ...', 'Captain, why? Our King – What have you done?', 'Vaan ...']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Alone ... Leave me alone. The hearts of humes are weak. I dare not grow close to them, lest mine grow weak as well.', 'Just when I began to grow close to them, they started killing each other. It is as I feared ... Hume behavior is savage and ugly.', 'I turned my back on my home to see the world of the humes, and what I found was slaughter and despicable weakness.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Mjrn ... her visage darkly clouded. A child of many gifts and much promise, yet she cannot bring her fierce spirit to heel. Ever do the storm clouds follow her ... but why?', 'I would join my fellow warriors, but apprentices are not permitted outside the village. It is a hardship for me. What has become of Mjrn ... ?', 'Mjrn has returned, but still a weight presses upon my heart. Why is this so? Is she ... different, somehow? Is there something I might do to help her?', "Betrayal begins with but a thought of the world beyond the Wood. This is why we fear its call. What found Mjrn in that beyond? Please, visit us no more. For Mjrn's sake, if no other."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["What's all this!? Are you ruffling my feathers?", 'Tell me: has Chit returned home?', "Why, yes! I can smell her pungent plumage on you even now! If you'll pardon me, I'm going to make for home at once. Do visit me in Giza, will you? Oh, and take this. A small token of my gratitude for everything you've done. Farewell!", 'I knew the answer before you spoke a word. Had you met her, you would bear traces of her pungent plumage.', "You must forgive me. Since departing my home on the Giza Plains, I've been gripped by the most terrific paranoia. As it happens, I recently came of age, whereupon I found myself in dire need of a mate. Sadly, Giza's candidates were ... underwhelming. So I quit those desolate plains, and soon found myself set upon by beasts intent on eating me, humes intent on selling me — barbarians all! Then it all became clear: Chit. She was the one! If she had returned to the plains, then I, too, would go home!", "Whats this? Have I told Chit how I feel yet? I should say not! That's not the way a gentleman goes about such things. Harumph!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Can't turn around without running into an Imperial today. Times like this, it's best to just keep your head down and stay outta trouble.", "I didn't understand a word of that speech, but I'll get Old Dalan to explain it to me. There's no one knows more than he does!", 'Vaan, is that you? I\'m surprised to see you here. All I\'ve heard out of Penelo lately is "Vaan\'s GONE!" She\'s been miserable. You should really go see her.', 'I had no idea Penelo had been kidnapped ... And to think, you were off rescuing her! I knew we could always count on you, Vaan!', "Seems like you've been keeping pretty busy lately. Penelo's been with you, right? Just make sure you two be careful. We don't want anything to happen to you, okay?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Ah, our guest. If you've finished talking with Lord Reddas, I suppose you'll be wanting to hear about the Feywood.", "These people? I see only a boy. And it's by Lord Reddas's command. If you have concerns ...", "Your concern's duly noted. I, for one, plan on following Lord Reddas's orders.", 'I apologize. Pay her no mind. Now, where was I? Ah, yes. South of the vast Golmore Jungle in Kerwon there lies a place known as the "Feywood." The Mist there is far denser than most, and even should you make it through that, there\'s no guarantee you\'ll make it past what lies beyond.', 'South of Gilmore Jungle in Kerwon lies the Feywood. Past that, the holy land of Giruvegan.', 'Hey, care for a bit of sport?', 'Let the tier 1 race begin!', "Nice, very nice! First place! Here's your prize!", "You've got a ways to go before you can hope to best us.", 'Right. More important things to do!']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Hha! I've been waiting for some time. You see, I am in need of assistance. Please, hear my words. I have been sent from Archadia to study the sandstorms of the Dalmasca Westersand, but the storms' violence makes such study ... impossible. There is a place in the desert, at the end of a long trail that winds through the north. Mayhap you know it. That is the site of my study. But before the wrath of such a storm, I can do nothing. This is why I seek help. Will you help me?", 'Thank you, my friend! I have made no progress on my own. I would like you to start by gathering information within Rabanastre. My own inquiries yielded little. There is one man who knows more than he will say. He sits atop the fountain in the plaza. He does not care for the Empire, so he will tell me nothing. Perhaps you will have better luck. I will be waiting to hear what you find.', 'Have you learned aught of the sandstorm in the Westersand? There is a man named Cotze, who sits atop the fountain in the plaza. He knows something of this, but when he learned I was from Archadia, he would say no more. Perhaps you will have better luck.', 'Hello there! You are looking well! It is me! The one sent to study the sandstorms in the Westersand ... do you not remember? As you can see, I am on holiday at the moment. Nothing came of my commission, but thankfully my other work has kept me busy ... Aah? The sandstorm has died down, you say? When you defeated the Earth Tyrant? Well, that deserves a hearty round of congratulations! I knew you would make it far! After all, you had me to guide you, yes? But you should have told me sooner! Mayhap there is a bonus in this for me ...', "Hha! I have been waiting for some time. You see, I am in need of assistance. Please, hear my words. I have been sent from Archadia to study the sandstorms of the Dalmasca Westersand, but the storms' violence makes such study ... impossible. There is a place in the desert, at the end of a long trail that winds through the north. Mayhap you know it. That is the site of my study. But before the wrath of such a storm, I can do nothing. This is why I seek help. Will you help me?", 'Thank you, my friend! I have made no progress on my own. I would like you to start by gathering information within Rabanastre. My own inquiries have yielded little. There is one man who knows more than he will say. He sits atop the fountain in the plaza. He does not care for the Empire, so he will tell me nothing. Perhaps you will have better luck. I will be waiting to hear what you find.', 'I am sorry to hear that. I must confess, I am at a loss as to how to proceed ... If you change your mind, I will be here.', "Aah, have you reconsidered my request? I'm still looking for help. There is a place in the desert, at the end of a long trail that winds through the north, where a sandstorm rages. It is the subject of my study. But before the wrath of such a storm, I can do nothing. I want you to assist me.", 'Will you help me?', 'Have you learned aught of the sandstorm in the Westersand? There is a man named Cotze, who sits atop the fountain in the plaza. He knows something of this, but when he learned I was from Archadia, he would say no more. Perhaps you will have better luck.', "Did he speak with you? Good, good. Don't let me interrupt your search.", 'I do not believe it!', "After the help you've given me, it pains me to say, but I've been relieved of my commission to study the sandstorms. Lack of results, they said ... I've nothing to give you by way of reward ... Pray, keep the windvane instead. Mayhap you will learn the secret of the sandstorm where I could not ... May your travels be safe."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['I have, my brother. She eats well.', "There's no fun in it if we can't tease out a scream or two!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Svagatam ... welcome ... Armor, not arms, is what we sell. Battle takes more than just a blade ...', 'Svagatam ... welcome ... Protectives ... protectives ... Why does Targe get all the business? What does he have that I do not?', 'Svagatam ... welcome ... Protectives ... protectives ... Why does Targe get all the business? Am I doing something wrong?', "Svagatam ... welcome ... Protectives, bhadra? 'Tis a dangerous world ... armor is what you need. (sigh) But you'll probably buy weapons first ..."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Sorry, but could you come back later? Gotta finish work, or I can't play!", "Jinn still isn't back? Masyua's gonna let us have it for sure. I knew he shouldn't have – nothing. Never mind. Well, ya see, Jinn and Tott kinda got in a fight. Then while they were busy fighting, a werewolf came along and ... I hope he's okay.", "Jinn and Tott started fighting near one of the crystals. We were all caught up with the fight, and that's when the werewolf came. We got split up while we were trying to get away ... Shoulda been more careful, I know. Now I have my sister mad at me, and Masyua, too! I think they're going a bit too hard on me.", "Seems like everythin's costin' more these days. I gotta have more money if I'm gonna buy anythin'. Would you, uh, talk to my sister for me?", "I really wanna go see Ozmone Plain. I hear there are all these old ruined airships just waitin' to be explored ... I get excited just thinkin' about it!", 'I really wanna travel. See strange places, talk to all sorts of people ... But before I can do that, I gotta convince my sister I can take care of myself. Whaddaya think? Does she trust me?']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Quite a tale, that one. And you've some tales of your own, piloting the boat all by yourself! I knew you'd got the river in your blood!", "We can only hope so. Still, they're a prickly lot. Can't imagine they'd give up that easily. (hearing a noise) Whoa, what's that!?", 'That is the leader of the cactoids.', "Stay back, Tchigri! They're just trying to find their son.", "That's right, they're a cactoid family. The eldest son, Dran, went missing, and they set out to find him. They came to our village along the way. Nothing but bad news, this Dran. He's part of a cactoid clan terrorizing the desert. There's even a bounty on his head. This one here's the matriarch of the family. She's been searching high and low for him. Wants to bring him back home and set him straight. But they couldn't find Dran anywhere in Dalmasca. That's why they needed us. She forced us to guide them to the lands beyond the desert. The Mosphoran Highwaste, the Salikawood ... even the Necrohol of Nabudis. I'd given up hope of ever making it back. And after all that, we still couldn't find him! So they brought us back here - for now. But who knows when they'll drag us off again?", "I don't think he's to the north of the river. We must've looked under every stone between here and Archadia. As for the south bank, well ... We weren't about to lead the cactoids there and get you and the others mixed up in this, too.", "I never figured on you coming to rescue me ... But there's no time for that now! We'll keep 'em busy while you search the south bank for Dran.", "Hello there! I'll never forget your help with those cactoids. I've got my son piloting the ferry, and I ... I have a lot of time on my hands. I'll have to find something to do with myself. Any ideas?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['South of ... Starfall Field ... There. The plain ...', '...']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Fighting against the Empire is all well and good, but it's not enough. You've got to find something more to live for. A dream to follow. I don't know what kind of world he'll grow up in, but so long as there are people who follow their dreams, it can't be all that bad.", "I can't believe he's still alive ... Sorry, just talking to myself. Promise me something, would you? No matter how hard things might get, never give up. So long as you don't give up, there's still hope.", "People think being a sky pirate is all riches and adventure, but the reality is far different. Your life is always at risk, you never know peace. You are free, I suppose. But it comes at a steep price. Your fate, succeed or fail, is entirely up to you. So what does it mean to be free? That's the real question. Running to escape your troubles won't make you free. It never can."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["I wanna see Torrie, but I ain't goin' nowhere near that bleedin' Nathyl. I ain't thick!", "I wanna see Torrie, but I ain't goin' nowhere near that bleedin' Nathyl. I ain't thick!", "Nathyl ain't nowhere to be seen! Now there's nuffink stoppin' me from poppin' over to the north Bank an' seein' Torrie!", "I bloomin' missed ya, Torrie! Wot's it gonna take to get ya to settle down wiv me, eh?", "Wot's Terra got to do wiv it? This is between you an' me, Torrie. Yer always tryin' to avoid it, but enough's enough! It's time to listen to yer 'eart!", "I'm yer fav'rite? 'Onest? Sure yer ain't pullin' me leg? Ya don't fancy Renn or Moomer?", "Yer 'ear that!? I'm only 'er blinkin' fav'rite! Me! Hoo hoo hoo! I betta 'urry back to Giza an' announce our plans fer the weddin'!", "I'll be waitin'! Can't 'ardly wait to see the look on ev'ryone's face when I give 'em the good news, though! Hoo hoo hoo! Thanks fer yer 'elp, son! I'd never 'ave gotten close enough to propose wivout ya! 'Ere's a little summink fer yer trouble!", "'Ave yer 'eard? Torrie said as she'd marry me! We'll make the 'appiest couple in the 'ist'ry o' the plains!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Don't mind me, boy. Just inspecting the weapons. Have to be sure nothing inappropriate is making its way to the average citizen, am I right?", "Fortunately, His Excellency the Consul has arrived without incident. Naturally, I kept up my weapons inspection throughout the ceremony. A moment of weakness or indiscretion can undo a lifetime's work. History's replete with examples of such. Our duty is to enforce the law unerringly.", "These weapons inspections may not seem like much, but they're vital to restricting the supply of arms to insurgents and other undesirables. What would happen if powerful weapons should find their way to the insurgents? War, that's what. So must we be ever vigilant.", "In addition to my inspections, I've been assigned patrols as well. The combat can be trying, I'm not ashamed to admit. I suppose I had let myself grow soft ... Mayhap this is just the proper medicine.", "We've received orders to stockpile weaponry, but the Empire's got enough trouble maintaining order as it is. People trust us little enough already. We'd only be throwing fuel on the fire. That's why I've decided not to purchase a single thing. Duty or no, I must answer to my conscience."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["There's nothing for you here, boy. Shopping the Outfitters is a privilege, see.", "Know where the Alley of Muted Sighs got 'er name? See, there's two kinds o' people 'ere: them as want to go up to the City ... An' them as want to keep those people down 'ere where they belong, tellin' 'em lies, an' spreadin' misinformation to confuse 'em. Them poor ones wot never made it up ... they're the ones wot are sighin', see? You ... weren't 'eaded up to the City, were ya?", "Its important time grab wotever information comes yer way ... but just as important to know Wot ya can and can't trust. Who, me? Heh heh! Oh, you can trust me, son! You can trust me..."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["'Allo! Shurry's me name an' peckin' at stuff's me game! Ha ha! Nah, not to worry, I ain't gonna peck ya! Just 'avin' a laugh, innit. Me? I live wiv the nomads back in Giza, norm'ly, I mean. But I got it inta me 'ead to find out 'ow the other 'alf live, so I thought I'd come 'ere. Di'n't realize 'ow far it was, but I got 'ere in the end, an' met a load o' them nice garifs. Cor, wot about them masks, eh!? Wish I 'ad one!", "Them sweets wot that garif bloke gave me fer bring back 'ere smelled so good, I 'ad 'em on the way. Ooooh, they was summink else, darlin'! Gorgeous don't do'em justice, I can tell ya!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Listen good, boy. I don't hate your kind, I just hate you. See? So do us a favor and leave us be, eh?", 'So it was you what bagged the mandragoras up Sochen way? Hah! Never woulda guessed it. Go talk to the Huntmaster.', 'If yer here to hunt, then get yerself over to the Huntmaster!', "Feh! A boy like you takin' the test? Huntmaster's gone soft, he has. Pah!", "So ye passed yer test. What of it? Bah. Suppose I'll have to tell ye a bit 'bout what it is we do here at the Hunt Club. Now listen up, this is what I want of ye. There're rare game out there what've mutated. They're a meaner 'n' nastier than even me. Yer usual marks, people want 'em dead after damage has been done, but we want ye to find these rare game 'fore lives are lost, see? These rare game, they aren't going to make it easy for you. Ye have to find 'em and bring 'em down before you know they're rare for sure ... if they drop a trophy when they fall, congratulations, ye've just found yerself rare game. Now, you bring them trophies back here when you get 'em. We won't pay you straight, like with them usual hunts, but you'll get yours. See, if ye bring in enough trophies, we'll put things out at the Outfitters for ye to buy. Give 'em to me, and I'll stock up on sundries. ...Ye could give 'em to my brothers, too, but that's be a sure sign o' poor taste. So, how 'bout it? Ye want to join the hunt? Say yes, and I'll send you on your way ... and you can turn them trophies in to whom ye please. 'Course, ye'd better please me. Well? Ye ready?", "So yer goin' to do it, after all? Pah. Waste o' time, I'd say, but in the unlikely event you do get a trophy, you bring it here to me. Anything you don't understand, you ask the Huntmaster. Don't bother me with your whining.", "Right. I didn't figure you had it in you.", "Harrumph? I don't see no trophy. Don't waste my precious time, boy.", 'If yer here to hunt, then get yerself over to the Huntmaster!', "Feh! Yer usual marks, people want 'em dead after damage has been done, but we want ye to find these rare game 'fore lives are lost, see? These rare game, they aren't going to make it easy for you. Ye have to find 'em and bring 'em down before you know they're rare for sure ... if they drop a trophy when they fall, congratulations, ye've just found yerself rare game. Now, you bring them trophies back here when you get 'em. We won't pay you straight, like with them usual hunts, but you'll get yours. See, if ye bring in enough trophies, we'll put things out at the Outfitters for ye to buy. Give 'em to me, and I'll stock up on sundries. ...Ye could give 'em to my brothers, too, but that's be a sure sign o' poor taste. So, how 'bout it? Ye want to join the hunt? Say yes, and I'll send you on your way ... and you can turn them trophies in to whom ye please. 'Course, ye'd better please me. Well? Ye ready?", "So yer goin' to do it, after all? Pah. Waste o' time, I'd say, but in the unlikely event you do get a trophy, you bring it here to me. Anything you don't understand, you ask the Huntmaster. Don't bother me with your whining.", "Right. I didn't figure you had it in you.", "Harrumph? I don't see no trophy. Don't waste my precious time, boy."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['Ah ... a hume-child. It is unusual for your kind to visit us here on our knoll. Have you come to speak with the Great-chief? He is in the meeting place before the bridge. You will know it by the guards standing at the entrance.', 'There is a creature wandering about the Zertinan Caverns that is surely to be posted as a mark ... if it is indeed not already being hunted.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['They are wayfarers. They bring no harm. I saw them cross the Ozmone Plain. They are warriors of great distinction. The fiends of the plains troubled them not at all.', '... ... ..', '...What business have you with the garif?', 'Let them pass. The responsibility will be mine.', 'Ah, I have not made introductions. I am Supinelu, War-chief of this village. We garif have been friends to all since long ago, however, lately the hume world is in much turmoil. We must protect our village, and our people. As War-chief, and protector of our village, I ask you: Why have you come to this land?', 'Hmm ... I see. So you too have come to ask about the nethicite. You must speak with the elders. Though our masks may make it difficult for you to tell us apart, walk through the village and look with your eyes, listen with your ears.', 'Have you learned of the Stones? Perhaps if you asked the elders, they might have wisdom for you.', 'That which you carry, is it a jaya stick?', 'The High-chief has given this ... to me? I shall receive it. I thank you for bringing it to me. Now, did you learn what you wished? No, do not tell me. It is written clear upon your face. So, even the High-chief could not help. Then, you must meet with the Great-chief.', 'Yes, it is true. The Great-chief may know something that would aid you. Yet, arranging an audience may be quite difficult ...', 'So you have learned nothing of the Stones? To think that even the High-chief did not know ... Then, you must meet with the Great-chief.', 'Yes, it is true. The Great-chief may know something that would aid you. Yet, arranging an audience may be quite difficult ...', 'Do you have proof of your heritage?', 'Hrm ... I have looked into your eyes and seen that you speak the truth, hume-child. I give you my trust. The Great-chief is ahead, across this bridge.', 'The Great-chief is across this bridge, at the meeting place. Walk softly, friend. Ah? You wonder about the stick? If you wish to know more, ask the High-chief. Do not ask me about this matter.', 'So, you will leave.', 'Take this as a token of our parting.', 'If you would ride a chocobo, you may. I have spoken with the moogle. She will not charge you for your first use of the chocobos. Take care on the road ahead. Should it lead back to our land, you are welcome guests. Spirits of the land watch over you.', 'Mt. Bur-Omisace lies far to the east. It will be a long journey to its paths. Walk softly, for in foolhardiness lies doom.', 'These men among us, these Judges, came here to protect someone important from Archadia. And now I hear this person will accompany you. The Judges will soon leave us too, and quiet shall return to our village.', 'You who walk the paths of Ivalice, I would give you advice. There are caves, called the Zertinan Caverns, near Ozmone Plain. The creatures that dwell in those caves are fell indeed. It is worth your life to venture inside. Be warned.', 'You who walk the paths of Ivalice, I would give you advice. There are caves, called the Zertinan Caverns, near Ozmone Plain. The creatures that dwell in those caves are fell indeed. It is worth your life to venture inside. Be warned.', 'There are many in the village who think me not fit to be War-chief. Of course, this is so. I am not like my brother before me, who was skilled in the ways of leading warriors. Yet ... the Catoblepas I shall slay! It is my duty to the village.']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Svagatam! Welcome to Targe's Arms!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Sorry, the ferry's not runnin' right now. My dad took the boat across to the north bank, but he hasn't come back. What's takin' so long?", "This is definitely my dad's boat. But where's my dad? Something bad must have happened ... I'm crossin' to the north bank to see what's going on. I know how to pilot the boat, and there's no point in waitin' around here worryin'.", "But what if my dad's in trouble? After him, there's no one that even knows how to pilot the boat 'cept me.", 'But ... my dad ...', "You just gotta! I'll pilot the boat. Whaddaya say?", "Thanks! What are we waitin' for!", 'Look! Over there! Are those ... cactoids?', "They must've attacked the north bank! What're we gonna do?", "Wait, there's my dad! And everyone else, too!", "I don't like the look of this one bit. Seems like they're holding 'em hostage. But what would cactoids want with hostages? I don't believe it!", "The cactoids all up and left! Now's our chance to go help my dad!", "I'm so glad you're all right! We didn't know what'd happened to you.", 'The others said it was too dangerous, but I knew I could handle it. But what about the cactoids? They ran off for good ... right?', 'Hey, prickle-pants! Who do you think you are, kidnapping my dad!?', "Find their son? You mean ... they're related?", "So there's a bounty on this Dran, huh? (to Vaan) You have any idea where he might be?", "So that's why you set the boat adrift - keep 'em from crossing!", "Right! Just leave it to us! Let's get going!", "You found the cactoid! What ... you didn't? You hunted the other one, but this one looks just like that one ... huh? Well, none of this makes much sense to me, but I guess we don't have much choice, huh. His family is waiting! Let's get him over to the north bank!", "Hurry up! If those cactoids start goin' crazy, who knows what'll happen to my dad and the others.", "Well, what're we waiting for!? Let's get him back to his family!", 'Hey, we found your son for you! Now let my dad go!', "Hmm, I dunno. You think they're buying it?", "Look at 'em go! Guess they're gonna take him in after all!", "The ferry's running again, if you wanna cross.", 'Well, just lemme know if you need to cross.', "The ferry's running again, if you wanna cross.", "Have you seen the cockatrice in the village? Its name's Sassan. Comes around every now and again. I think it's friends with Torrie. You should help Sassan cross the river to see her. But poor Sassan's scared to death of Nathyl, so it won't be easy ...", 'Who will you put on the ferry?', "Here we go, Sassan. That's a good boy!", "Come on, Arryl. Let's go!", "Let's go, Nathyl. Here boy!", 'Well, just lemme know if you need to cross.', "You should help Sassan cross from the south bank. 'Course, Sassan won't go near Nathyl, so it could be kinda tricky ..."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["I heard wild cockatrices can roll real fast. But these ones don't roll around at all ... You think they're just lazy?", "But this time Roaklo was with them, too. I wonder what's going on?", 'Hmm ...', "Roaklo, Tott, and Jinn went out onto the plain, but Jinn still hasn't come back. To tell the truth, I'm a bit worried.", 'Hee hee!', "Sure, I know Jinn. Brunoa was complimenting the sunstones he made, and I think it made Tott jealous. I just don't get it. Why can't they just get along with each other?", "Jinn isn't originally from here, you know. Brunoa brought him from Rabanastre. She says he's another orphan of the war. But here we're all treated the same, so what difference should it make? Maybe it still bothers him. Or maybe it bothers me ...", "The cockatrices aren't lookin' so good lately. Can't you tell? You gotta look close. And poor Dania ... I wish there was something I could do to help out.", "Dania asked me to help her tend the cockatrices. Everything was goin' along fine, then all of a sudden they darted out of the pen ... Now they're gone, and it's all my fault! What am I gonna do? If I'd only had one of them magick feathers that Dania uses to talk to 'em, this wouldn't have happened.", "Dania asked me to help her tend the cockatrices. Everything was goin' along fine, then all of a sudden they darted out of the pen ... Now they're gone, and it's all my fault! What am I gonna do? If I'd only had one of them magick feathers that Dania uses to talk to 'em, this wouldn't have happened.", "All the cockatrices are finally back! Dania told me it's all 'cause of you ... thank you!", "I'll do better this time. Who needs a magick feather, anyway? I'll figure out what they're thinkin' on my own!", "I guess they all came back 'cause they'd finished their adventures. I'm kinda jealous ... they've been places I haven't even been! Dania asked me to help her watch them again. I'm still a bit nervous, but I won't let her down this time!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Ah, Vaan. Migelo send you, too, did he? He's a busy man these days, that Migelo, if I dare say so myself. I don't envy him the work, though. Not a bit. Quite an affair, throwing a banquet to welcome the Imperials, eh?", "Ah, don't remind me. Got some nastiness out there in the Estersand what's stopping our couriers ... and that means shortages all around. Thought I'd put up a bill ... offer a reward to anyone who can knock that nasty back in its place.", "So here's how it works. People post bills here on the notice board when they have a monster they need taken care of. Headhunters track people, right? Well, hunters track monsters. The monster you're hunting is called your mark. Here's the bill I posted for the Rogue Tomato, the mark I've petitioned to have hunted. Do you want to hear all the details?", 'Let\'s start with accepting hunts. You can\'t just take a look at the board, then go running off to hunt the mark. You\'ll miss out on the bounty. You gotta talk to the person who posted the bill - the petitioner - first. Let him know you\'re going on the hunt. So, take this Rogue Tomato bill, for example. I posted it, so I\'m the petitioner. You have to come talk to me. Let\'s call that step "done," okay? Once your agreement\'s in place, the petitioner will tell you how to find the mark. Then you hunt it, report back, and claim the bounty. Oh, and I\'ll give you something to help keep track of your hunts: a clan primer. Use it to refresh your memory about hunts you\'ve accepted.', "Go ahead and take this, while you're at it. Just a little something to commemorate your first hunt.", "All right, but I'll be expecting you to take care of that Rogue Tomato for me. Oh, and I'll give you something to help keep track of your hunts: a clan primer. Use it to refresh your memory about hunts you've accepted.", "Go ahead and take this, while you're at it. Just a little something to commemorate your first hunt.", "Hmm, looks like you can't equip that yet. Know why? You don't have the license for it. Think of licenses as mile posts, marking your progress as your combat skills improve. Swords, bows, black magicks, white magicks ... none of it does you a lick of good until you have the license to use it. Same goes for that armlet. Tomaj, how can I equip this great treasure you've bestowed on me, you ask? Easy: learn by doing. Let's give it a try.", "You can acquire a new license anytime you like from the Party Menu. First, decide whose licenses you want to examine. I don't see anyone else here, so it looks like that means you, Vaan.", "This is the license board. The license board shows which licenses you already have, as well as some new ones waiting to be obtained. Licenses you've acquired are marked with a star.", "Looks like right now you can equip Leather Clothing, Leather Caps, and Mythril Swords, and you have the technick to Steal from your foes. Heh, still a little wet behind the ears. We all have to start somewhere, though. The more licenses you have, the more equipment you'll be able to use, and the more abilities you'll have to choose from.", "But a license alone isn't enough. Did you notice how Mythril Blade was darkened? That's because you don't have one in your inventory. You'll need to buy magicks from a magick shop, and arms from a smithy before you'll be able to put those licenses to use. It doesn't matter which you get first, magicks and equipment, or the license to use them, so long as you have both. You can use any magicks and technicks in your possession as soon as you acquire the necessary license. But you'll have to equip weapons and armor before they'll do you any good. Got it?", "All right, let's take a look at that number in the top left. These are your license points. You spend these points to acquire new licenses. You can acquire any license that's next to one you already have, but only if you have enough license points.", "Ah, this should do! Why don't you try obtaining this license now? Select the license and press X. Then you'll have the Accessories 1 license.", "Now you shouldn't have any trouble equipping that orrachea armlet I gave you. Just don't forget to equip it, okay? You probably noticed already, but when you obtained that license, several new ones appeared on the board.", "You don't have enough license points to obtain any more now, but take down a few monsters and you'll have the points before you know it. Don't be in a hurry to spend all your points, though. Think about which licenses you really need, or you might regret it later. Oh, let me show you one thing while I'm at it. Go ahead and press □.", "That list shows all of the actions you can take during battle. It can definitely come in handy. Well, if you can remember all that, you shouldn't have any trouble taking down a mark or two on your own.", "I'd say you're ready to hunt that mark for me. Oh, you'll be needing this to leave the city. Just show it to the watch at the gate.", "The east gate's the one you'll want to head out. Once you've taken care of that mark for me, let me know. Your work won't go unrewarded.", 'Hi, Vaan. Something I can help you with?', "Marks are monsters that a petitioner posts a bill to have hunted. Successfully hunting marks will earn you a small bounty. See that notice board over on the wall? That's where you can go to see what bills have been posted. It all starts there. But just looking at the bill isn't enough. You have to go talk to the petitioner and accept the hunt before setting out. The bill will always tell you where to find the petitioner. Once you've accepted the hunt, you're ready to track down the mark using the information given to you by the petitioner. If you're able to defeat the mark, report back to the petitioner. That completes the hunt, and you should receive your bounty. Simple, right? The best way to learn is by doing. Hunt a few marks on your own and you'll have it down in no time.", "Ah, Vaan. I meant to tell you: this isn't the only notice board you'll find. Most cities – even some villages – have their own board. The good news is, all of the notice boards have the same bills. So you can go to the closest board without worrying about checking them all.", 'Each and every battle-related ability has a license that entitles you to use it. Say you want to cast the white magick "Cure." You have to obtain the license for it first. The same is true of equipment. Even the most devastating weapon won\'t do you any good if you don\'t have the license to equip it. The licenses you have determine how you can fight, so think before you choose.', "Ah, Vaan. I meant to tell you: this isn't the only notice board you'll find. Most cities – even some villages – have their own board. The good news is, all of the notice boards have the same bills. So you can go to the closest board without worrying about checking them all.", "You'll never find that Rogue Tomato standing around in here. The Imperials have started locking down the gates for the parade, but you ought to be able to get out if you show them that writ I gave you. Just talk to the watch by the east gate in the Southern Plaza. You shouldn't have any trouble.", 'Ah, Vaan! Defeated that Rogue Tomato, did you? I was worried you might not be ready just yet, but you did a fine job of it! Here. Your bounty for completing the hunt.', "Oh, I hear you stopped by the clan hall. You're one shrewd customer. I'm sure you heard all manner of things from the other hunters, but just take your time to ease into it and you'll do fine."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Well, if it isn't Sassan! Run away from Giza again, have you? Terra must be worried sick!", "I'm so glad you came all this way to see me, but think of your poor friends back in Giza. It's not fair to them. Think how Terra must feel. You know you're the only cockatrice for me, Sassan. Now be a good boy and head back home to Giza, all right?", "You know you're my favorite, Sassan.", 'All right, Sassan. Off to Giza with you now. Give my best to Terra and Dania!', "Did you help Sassan reach the north Bank? That couldn't have been easy. He can be a bit of a chicken at times. Take this for your trouble.", "An errand saw me in Giza when Sassan and his friends hatched. Ever since, he's come to visit me from time to time. I think he must think I'm his mother or something. Isn't he adorable?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["Hey there. We don't see many travelers through here. If there's somethin' you're lookin' for, you should talk to our elder. She's over by the tent.", "We all went out to make some sunstones, but Jinn still hasn't come back to camp. It's the first time he's been out on the plains since the end of the Rains. Maybe he got a touch of wanderlust.", "Worried? About Jinn? Not me. Nobody knows Giza Plains better than we do. Gotta make these sunstones fast, and they gotta be good, too. That's what Masyua says. I guess she knows what she's talkin' about.", "Our fathers have gone stone-digging. That's why the only adults here are all women. Bet you were wondering where all the men went!", "Didya see? The dark crystals out on the plains are all glowin' again. Time to make sunstones! You wanna make sunstones, too? You should talk to my mom. She's over in front of that biiig crystal.", 'Little while ago, the whole west sky lit up in a flash. Only lasted for a second. Wonder what that was ...', "I asked Jinn what his secret for makin' sunstones is. No matter what I try, his always turn out better. Turns out he wanted to know how come I can make mine so fast. Kinda funny, huh?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['This nethicite - you have used it.', 'You do not know the workings of the Stone. Then we are no different.', "In ages past, the gods made a gift of nethicite to my people. But the manner of its use eluded us. Displeased by our failure, the gods took back their Stones. They chose instead to give them to a hume king. Called the Dynast-King, he used the nethicite's power to bring peace to a troubled time. It is a curious thing. Though the blood of King Raithwall flow through your veins, you cannot wield nethicite.", "Though it shame me so to admit. Here before me stands a descendant of the Dynast-King himself ... and I can accord her no help at all. Still, even if you knew how to use the nethicite, you would find it of small avail. The Mist collected in the Stone over ages past is lost, and with it the Stone's power. It will be your posterity who wield the Stone in ages yet to come.", 'This Stone is devoid of power. Empty, yet full of thirst. A terrible longing to drink the world dry. The power of men, and of magick. Of good, and of evil. It is often those who desire nethicite whom the nethicite itself desires.', 'You go to Mt. Bur-Omisace, yes? There is one in the village selling provisions. You might speak with him.', 'The nethicite you hold, its power is spent. It will be your posterity who wield the Stone in ages yet to come. The Stone ... is full of thirst, as are those who desire it. Once they find each other, who knows where they will go?', 'I have been told that the hume armies head toward the land to the east. I had hoped that this conflict would be averted ...', 'In our village, time passes slowly. If you should tire on your journey, come and rest here. The Land will renew you, body and spirit. The burden you carry, it is heavier than most. Rest when you can.', 'A visitor from Giza? Ah, it will not do to let her leave empty-handed. I am quite indebted to the nomads there. I would ask a favor of you. Would you deliver this to our guest for me, and also pass on my regards to Brunoa, Elder of the nomads?']

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ["I've walked this way too many times to count, procuring wares in Archadia ... 'cept I never lost my partner before this time.", "I got a baaaaad feeling about this ... Might be time to post a bill for one of them — what were they called? Marks? Eh? Sorry, don't mind me."]

Title: Final Fantasy XII
Dialogues: ['I know, I know! Just a little more. You keep an eye out for me up there, Kytes.', 'One ... two ... three more. Right. Time to clean house.', "Hey, it's good practice for the desert. I'm ready for anything now. That's enough for today. You should get back to Migelo's place, Kytes. Aren't you running errands for him?", 'I got other "work" to do. Hey, lock this place up for me, will you? If Migelo finds out we\'ve been down here, he\'ll tan our hides.', 'Sorry!', "Hey, that's mine!", "Oh, what, am I the leader now? We're orphans. The first thing you learn is you gotta look out for yourself. C'mon, Penelo. You know it as well as I do ...", "Hey, you give that back! What do you think you're doing?", 'Yeah, but, I never said anything about taking it back from me!', 'I know that. You think I like living like this?', "One of these days, I'll fly an airship of my own. I'll be a sky pirate, free to go where I will.", 'I should probably make myself scarce right about now.', "Sure, let's hear it.", 'No, thanks.', 'I should really go see Migelo first.', 'Penelo said you needed something?', 'So you want me to find this courier? Hey, no problem!', "So, you want me to go to the tavern to pick 'em up.", 'Sounds wild.', 'There you are, Kytes. Stop loafing around!', '"Creature spotted in the Estersand."
